<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
================================================================================
  REPORT: Custom Supplement WO  (Infinit Nutrition)
  PATH:   Custom/Infinit_Nutrition/Custom_Supplement_WO.htm
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Infinit Nutrition sell a Custom Supplements range: the customer picks a base
  product and specifies per-order customisations, which arrive as preformatted
  text in soitem.note --

      Flavour: Banana, Electrolyte Mix: Med, Caffeine: 50mg

  This report lists the open SO lines carrying those products, parses each note
  into structured attributes, resolves the recipe into a concrete component
  list, and creates the Manufacture Order with those quantities in a single
  POST /api/manufacture-orders call. (Fishbowl generates the work orders when
  the MO is Issued -- there is no create-a-WO endpoint, so "create a custom
  work order" means creating the MO that produces it.)

  WHERE THE QUANTITIES COME FROM. The variable items take their quantity from
  this report's own RECIPE CONFIGURATION, deliberately SEPARATE from the
  Fishbowl BOM: the BOM supplies the fixed base ingredients, the part and UOM
  ids, and the bom.id each configuration builds against, while the config
  supplies what changes per order. Where the config has nothing to say the BOM
  figure is kept and the drawer warns -- it is never guessed.

  The config is EDITABLE IN THE CLIENT, from the "Recipe" button in the topbar
  (readable by anyone, editable by an admin). One record per pack: choose the
  base BOM by type-ahead, then add customisable items -- each with a mapping
  type (named scale / numeric+unit / substitution), a part chosen from a
  filtered part list, and its levels and quantities. That is how a new pack
  size gets configured, without touching this file or the BOM.

  SKELETON STATUS -- the discovery pattern is still a hardcoded fixture, as is
  the fallback base recipe used when a product has no live BOM; each carries a
  TODO naming what replaces it. The read path and the create path
  are both real. Fixture-derived payloads can never be posted: the base recipe
  must come from a live BOM and every component must resolve to a live part.id +
  uom.id before Create enables, and rows sourced from SAMPLE_ROWS are refused
  outright.

  Chrome + layout follow Manufacturing/WO_Finisher.htm (v1.2 "Workspace"), on
  the shared fb-lib / fb-mfg / fb-styles assets.
================================================================================
-->
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>Custom Supplement WO - Fishbowl BI</title>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />

  <!-- Moment.js - fb-lib's Common.formatDate uses moment to format dates
       against the install's DateFormatShort (e.g. dd/MM/yyyy for AU). Without
       it the fallback returns YYYY-MM-DD, which reads wrong on non-US installs.
       MUST load BEFORE fb-lib so its formatDate sees `typeof moment`. -->
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/moment.js/2.29.4/moment.min.js"></script>

  <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI lib - inlined by Fishbowl from the saved "fb-lib"
       script. Source of truth: scripts/fb-lib.js. Must come BEFORE fb-mfg
       (which reads FBLib.Common), before the fb-styles style, and before this
       report's inline script at the bottom of body. -->
  <script>
    {% Script fb-lib %}
  </script>

  <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI MANUFACTURING logic - saved "fb-mfg" script. Source of
       truth: scripts/fb-mfg.js. Defines FBMfg (Finisher / Scrap / Staging).
       MUST come AFTER fb-lib. -->
  <script>
    {% Script fb-mfg %}
  </script>

  <!-- Shared chrome: fb-styles. -->
  <style>
    {% Style fb-styles %}
  </style>

  <style>
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0;
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }
    /* Body reserves bottom space for the fb-lib debug drawer. The drawer is
       fixed-bottom; --debug-drawer-h is maintained by observeDebugDrawer(). */
    body { padding-bottom: var(--debug-drawer-h, 0px); transition: padding-bottom 0.12s ease; }
    .wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; }

    /* fb-drawer body grid. fb-styles supplies the drawer chrome; these lay out
       grouped fields. */
    .fb-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 22px; align-items: flex-start; }
    .fb-group { flex: 1 1 220px; min-width: 220px; }
    .fb-group-title {
      font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #475569; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
      padding-bottom: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .fb-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .fb-field label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #475569; }
    .fb-field select {
      height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 0 8px; font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit;
      color: var(--c-primary); background: #fff; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .ds-btn { padding: 7px 13px; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 7px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background: #fff; cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit; font-weight: 600; color: #334155; }
    .ds-btn:hover { background: #f1f5f9; }
    .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; border-color: var(--color-primary); }
    .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark); }
    .ds-btn-admin { background: #fef3c7; border-color: #f59e0b; color: #7c2d12; margin-right: 6px; }
    .ds-lock-badge { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; border: 1px solid #f59e0b;
      padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .muted { color: var(--c-tertiary); }

    /* KPI BAR */
    #kpiBar {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #f1f5f9;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* FILTER CHIP STRIP */
    #filtersBar {
      background: white; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 8px 16px;
      flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 14px; align-items: center;
      position: relative; z-index: 30;
    }
    .fl-label {
      font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #64748b; padding: 4px 8px; background: #f1f5f9; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .fl-divider { width: 1px; height: 22px; background: #e2e8f0; flex-shrink: 0; }

    /* Multi-select trigger (matches WO_Finisher / WO_Parts_Availability) */
    .ms-container { position: relative; }
    .ms-trigger {
      display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: nowrap; gap: 3px;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 3px 8px;
      background: white; height: 30px; min-width: 180px; overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px;
    }
    .ms-trigger:hover { border-color: #cbd5e1; }
    .ms-tag { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px;
      font-size: 11px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; white-space: nowrap; }
    .ms-tag-x { cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; }
    .ms-placeholder { color: #9ca3af; }
    .ms-dropdown {
      position: absolute; z-index: 500; top: calc(100% + 2px); left: 0;
      min-width: 260px; max-width: 380px; background: white;
      border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 6px;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.13);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 360px;
    }
    .ms-dropdown.hidden { display: none !important; }
    .ms-search { padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6; }
    .ms-search input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; outline: none; font-family: inherit; }
    .ms-actions { padding: 4px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6;
      display: flex; gap: 10px; font-size: 11px; }
    .ms-actions span { color: #3b82f6; cursor: pointer; }
    .ms-actions span:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
    .ms-list { overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; }
    .ms-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 10px;
      cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; }
    .ms-item:hover { background: #eff6ff; }
    .ms-empty { padding: 12px; color: #9ca3af; font-size: 12px; text-align: center; }

    /* MAIN TABLE */
    #tableScroll { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; background: var(--bg-1); position: relative; }
    table.cs { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12.5px; background: white; }
    table.cs th {
      background: var(--menu-bg); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px;
      text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px; white-space: nowrap;
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }
    table.cs th.nr { text-align: right; }
    table.cs th.sortable { cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }
    table.cs th.sortable:hover { background: var(--menu-bg-2); }
    .sort-arrow { display: inline-block; min-width: 10px; margin-left: 4px;
      opacity: 0.55; font-size: 9px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .sort-arrow.active { opacity: 1; }
    table.cs td { padding: 6px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); vertical-align: middle; }
    table.cs td.nr { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .empty { text-align: center; color: var(--c-tertiary); font-style: italic; padding: 26px 10px !important; }

    /* SO group header row */
    tr.so-row td { background: var(--tint-blue); font-weight: 600; border-top: 2px solid var(--fb-blue); }
    tr.so-row:first-child td { border-top: none; }
    tr.so-row .twisty { display: inline-flex; width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-right: 6px;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; color: var(--c-secondary);
      transition: transform 0.12s; user-select: none; }
    tr.so-row.expanded .twisty { transform: rotate(90deg); }

    /* Line row */
    tr.line-row td { background: #fff; }
    tr.line-row:hover td { background: var(--bg-1); }
    tr.line-row.collapsed { display: none; }
    tr.line-row td.indent { padding-left: 28px; }
    .row-link { color: var(--link); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; }
    .row-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
    .row-build { margin-left: 8px; }

    /* Customisation chips - the parsed soitem.note attributes. */
    .cs-chips { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; }
    .cs-chip {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
      background: var(--tint-blue-2); color: #14496B; border: 1px solid #A8CFEA;
      border-radius: var(--r-pill); padding: 1px 8px;
      font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .cs-chip .k { opacity: .7; font-weight: 500; }
    /* An attribute we could not map -> must stay visible, never silently dropped. */
    .cs-chip.unknown { background: var(--acc-orange-bg); color: var(--acc-orange-con); border-color: #EBC49B; }
    /* An accepted level with no part mapped yet: needs attention (amber) but
       does NOT block, unlike .unknown. */
    .cs-chip.unmapped { background: var(--acc-orange-bg); color: var(--acc-orange-con);
      border-color: #EBC49B; border-style: dashed; }
    .cs-chip.none { background: var(--bg-2); color: var(--c-tertiary); border-color: var(--border);
      font-style: italic; font-weight: 500; }
    .cs-sample { background: var(--acc-purple-bg); color: var(--acc-purple-con); border: 1px solid #B9A6F0;
      border-radius: var(--r-pill); padding: 1px 7px; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-left: 6px; }

    /* Adjustment annotation in the drawer's component table. */
    .cs-adj { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }
    .cs-adj.mult  { color: var(--fb-blue-accent); }
    .cs-adj.delta { color: var(--acc-orange-con); }
    /* An absolute per-serve set (Caffeine) and a part substitution (Flavour). */
    .cs-adj.set   { color: var(--acc-purple-con); }
    .cs-adj.sub   { color: var(--c-secondary); }
    /* Shown but NOT applied — the BOM quantity is what will be built. */
    .cs-adj.unapplied { text-decoration: line-through; opacity: .65; }
    .cs-adj.none  { color: var(--c-tertiary); font-weight: 400; }
    .cs-zero { color: var(--fb-negative); font-weight: 700; }

    /* Loading overlay (pairs with fb-styles s19 .spin) */
    #loadOverlay {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 30; display: none;
      flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px;
      background: rgba(247,247,247,.82); color: var(--c-secondary); font-size: 12px;
    }
    #loadOverlay.show { display: flex; }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    .spin { animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite; }
    .fb-drawer-body code { background: var(--bg-2); padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px;
      font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; }
    .fb-drawer-body ul { margin: 4px 0; padding-left: 18px; }

    /* Larger button glyphs. fb-styles s23 sizes .ps-btn.sm svg at 14px; this
       report's icons carry finer strokes, so bump them. Local style loads after
       fb-styles, so this wins. */
    .ps-btn svg, .ps-btn.sm svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
    .ps-btn.icon, .ps-btn.icon.sm { width: 32px; padding: 0; }
    .ps-btn.sm.row-build svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    /* Toast stack */
    .toast-container { position: fixed; bottom: 16px; right: 16px; z-index: 10130;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; pointer-events: none; }
    .toast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-width: 260px; max-width: 380px;
      background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-left: 4px solid var(--fb-neutral);
      border-radius: var(--r-card); box-shadow: var(--sh2); padding: 10px 13px;
      font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--c-primary); transition: opacity .3s; }
    .toast.success { border-left-color: var(--fb-success); }
    .toast.error   { border-left-color: var(--fb-negative); }
    .toast.info    { border-left-color: var(--fb-blue); }
    .toast-icon { font-weight: 700; }
    .toast.success .toast-icon { color: var(--fb-success); }
    .toast.error   .toast-icon { color: var(--fb-negative); }
    .toast.info    .toast-icon { color: var(--fb-blue); }

    /* ==============================================================
       BUILD DRAWER - one slide-in tier over the list. Same .scrim /
       .detail / .pf-* vocabulary as WO_Finisher's finish drawer, so the
       resolved-component table reads identically.
       ============================================================== */
    .scrim { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
      background: rgba(16,16,16,.35); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
      transition: .2s; z-index: 10001; }
    .scrim.on { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
    .detail { position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 100vh;
      width: 680px; max-width: 94vw; background: #fff; z-index: 10002;
      box-shadow: var(--sh3); transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .detail.on { transform: translateX(0); }
    .detail-head { padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .detail-head .top { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
    .detail-head-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
    .detail-actions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 6px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .detail-actions .close-x { align-self: flex-end; }
    .detail-actions .ps-btn { justify-content: center; white-space: nowrap; }
    .detail-head .so { font-family: var(--mono); font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; color: var(--link); }
    .detail-head h2 { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 800; margin: 0; letter-spacing: -.01em; color: var(--c-primary); }
    .detail-head .sub { font-size: 13px; color: var(--c-secondary); margin-top: 3px; }
    .detail-head .mono { font-family: var(--mono); }
    .detail-body { padding: 16px 20px; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; }
    .dsec { margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .dsec h4 { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--c-tertiary); margin: 0 0 10px; }
    .close-x { width: 32px; height: 32px; }
    .close-x svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
    #buildScrim { z-index: 10003; }
    #buildPanel { z-index: 10004; }

    /* Preflight banner + primary action. */
    .pf-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap;
      padding: 11px 13px; border-radius: var(--r-card); border-left: 4px solid var(--fb-neutral);
      background: var(--bg-1); margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .pf-banner.ok   { border-left-color: #A9CDBA; background: #F1F7F3; }
    .pf-banner.warn { border-left-color: #EBC49B; background: #FBF4EC; }
    .pf-banner.late { border-left-color: #D9A4B2; background: #F7ECEF; }
    .pf-banner .pf-summary { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 10px; align-items: center; }
    .pf-banner .pf-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .pf-banner .ps-btn.primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }
    .pf-blocker-list { margin: 2px 0 14px 18px; padding: 0; font-size: 12px; color: #8A1E30; }
    .pf-blocker-list li { margin: 3px 0; }
    .pf-warn-list { margin: 2px 0 14px 18px; padding: 0; font-size: 12px; color: #8A4E10; }
    .pf-warn-list li { margin: 3px 0; }
    .pf-steps { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; }

    /* Resolved-component table. */
    .pf-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; }
    .pf-tablewrap { margin-top: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--r-card); max-height: 340px; overflow: auto; }
    .pf-table th { background: var(--bg-1); color: var(--c-secondary); text-align: left;
      font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em;
      padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; }
    .pf-table td { padding: 7px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-2); vertical-align: top; }
    .pf-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
    .pf-table td.num, .pf-table th.num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .pf-table tr.fg-line td { background: #F1F7F3; font-weight: 600; }
    .pf-table tr.bad-line td { background: #F7ECEF; }
    .pf-table input[type="number"] { width: 88px; height: 26px; padding: 2px 6px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 5px; font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 12px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      background: #fff; color: var(--c-primary); }
    .pf-table input[type="number"]:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--fb-blue);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45,156,219,.15); }
    .pf-table input[type="number"].dirty { border-color: var(--fb-warning); background: #FBF4EC; }
    .pf-table .pf-partn { font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-primary); }
    .pf-table .pf-desc { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--c-secondary); }
    /* A per-pack quantity taken from the RECIPE CONFIG rather than the BOM.
       Marked because "which number won" is the question this table has to
       answer at a glance. */
    .pf-table td.cfgq, .pf-note .cfgq { color: var(--acc-purple-con); font-weight: 700; }
    .pf-note .cfgq { font-weight: 600; }
    .pf-note { font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--c-secondary); margin: 6px 0 0; }
    /* One row per existing MO on the order: what it covers, then its own
       Open MO button. */
    .pf-existing { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      justify-content: space-between; padding: 5px 0; }
    .pf-existing + .pf-existing { border-top: 1px solid var(--bg-2); }
    .pf-existing .ps-btn { flex-shrink: 0; }
    .pf-rawnote { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11.5px; background: var(--bg-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-btn);
      padding: 7px 9px; white-space: pre-wrap; color: var(--c-primary); margin-top: 6px; }

    /* ==============================================================
       RECIPE CONFIGURATION EDITOR — a wider drawer tier than the build
       drawer, because it holds nested editable tables. Same scrim /
       .detail vocabulary, so ESC and the stack behave identically.
       ============================================================== */
    #setupScrim { z-index: 10005; }
    #setupPanel { z-index: 10006; width: 1120px; max-width: 96vw; }
    .cs-setup-body { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; display: flex; overflow: hidden; }
    .cs-setup-rail { width: 232px; flex-shrink: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      overflow-y: auto; background: var(--bg-1); padding: 10px 0 14px; }
    .cs-setup-main { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; overflow-y: auto; padding: 14px 18px; }
    .cs-rail-title { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--c-tertiary); padding: 0 14px 8px; }
    .cs-rail-row { position: relative; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer;
      border-left: 3px solid transparent; }
    .cs-rail-row:hover { background: var(--bg-2); }
    .cs-rail-row.on { background: #fff; border-left-color: var(--fb-blue); }
    .cs-rail-main { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-primary); }
    .cs-rail-sub { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--c-secondary); margin-top: 1px; }
    .cs-rail-flag { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 10px; width: 16px; height: 16px;
      border-radius: 50%; background: var(--fb-negative); color: #fff; font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .cs-rail-empty { padding: 4px 14px 10px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--c-tertiary);
      font-style: italic; }
    .cs-rail-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 12px 0;
      margin-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }

    .cs-card { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card);
      background: #fff; padding: 12px 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .cs-card-title { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--c-tertiary); margin-bottom: 10px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-2); padding-bottom: 6px; }
    .cs-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 14px; }

    <!-- HELP - fb-drawer style -->
    <div id="helpOverlay" class="fb-drawer">
      <div class="fb-drawer-head">
        <h2>📖 How to read this report</h2>
        <button type="button" class="fb-drawer-close" onclick="FBLib.Common.closeDrawer('helpOverlay')" aria-label="Close">×</button>
      </div>
      <div class="fb-drawer-body">
        <div class="fb-grid">
          <div class="fb-group" style="flex:1 1 320px;">
            <div class="fb-group-title">The note format</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              Each custom-supplement line carries its customisation in <code>soitem.note</code> as
              <code>Attribute: Level</code> pairs, separated by commas, semicolons or newlines:
            </p>
            <div class="pf-rawnote">Flavour: Banana, Electrolyte Mix: Med
Caffeine: 50mg</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              <strong>Exactly three things are customisable</strong> — everything else on the
              BOM is a fixed base ingredient and must not appear in the note:
            </p>
            <ul style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              <li><strong>Flavour</strong> — which flavour raw good fills the flavour slot</li>
              <li><strong>Electrolyte Mix</strong> — <code>Low</code> / <code>Med</code> /
                  <code>High</code> (400 / 500 / 1000 mg per serve, which are also accepted
                  as the level)</li>
              <li><strong>Caffeine</strong> — <code>0</code> / <code>25</code> / <code>50</code> /
                  <code>75</code> / <code>100</code> mg <em>per serve</em></li>
            </ul>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              Matching ignores case, spaces and punctuation, so <code>electrolyte: low</code> and
              <code>Electrolyte Mix: Low</code> are the same, and caffeine takes <code>50</code>,
              <code>50mg</code> or <code>50 mg</code> (and <code>None</code> for zero). A fragment
              with no colon is treated as prose and ignored, so an ordinary shipping comment can sit
              alongside the attributes.
            </p>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              An attribute we can't map — an unknown name, or a caffeine/electrolyte value off
              its scale — renders as an <span class="cs-chip unknown">⚠ amber chip</span>
              and <strong>blocks the build</strong>. It is never silently dropped: catching bad notes
              is the point of this report.
            </p>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              Flavour is the exception. Its list is open, so any flavour is accepted; one with no part
              mapped yet shows as a <span class="cs-chip unmapped">✎ dashed chip</span>, keeps the
              BOM's own flavour line, and <strong>warns instead of blocking</strong> — swap the
              raw good by hand on the work order.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div class="fb-group" style="flex:1 1 320px;">
            <div class="fb-group-title">How the recipe resolves</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              The variable quantities live in this report's <strong>recipe configuration</strong>,
              deliberately <em>separate</em> from the Fishbowl BOM, so an admin can adjust them
              without editing the BOM. Per component:
            </p>
            <ul style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              <li>a <strong>base ingredient</strong> keeps the BOM's own quantity</li>
              <li>a <strong>variable item</strong> takes an absolute figure per pack from the
                  configuration, which <em>replaces</em> whatever the BOM line says</li>
              <li><strong>Flavour</strong> also says which <code>FLV-RTU-*</code> raw good fills the
                  slot — the mass is the same whichever flavour</li>
              <li>then every line is multiplied by the ordered quantity</li>
            </ul>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              For the 25-serve pack the configured figures are electrolytes
              <code>49.07</code> / <code>61.14</code> / <code>122.28</code> g for
              Low / Med / High, and caffeine <code>0</code> / <code>1.3</code> / <code>2.5</code> /
              <code>3.8</code> / <code>5</code> g for 0–100 mg per serve.
            </p>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              <strong>The <em>Recipe</em> button in the topbar opens the configuration</strong>,
              where an admin chooses each pack's base BOM and edits its items, levels and
              quantities. Anyone can read it; only an admin can publish a change. Adding a pack
              there is all it takes to support a new size — no BOM edit, no report change.
            </p>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              Those grams are <strong>not</strong> the pure ingredient mass, which is why they are
              stored verbatim rather than calculated: 100 mg of caffeine per serve on a
              25-serve pack is 5 g of raw material, not 2.5 g, because the raw good is
              roughly half caffeine by weight. Deriving the figure would understate it by half.
            </p>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              A pack with no configuration, a level with no figure, or a flavour whose part is not in
              Fishbowl all keep the BOM quantity, show the adjustment
              <span class="cs-adj set unapplied">struck through</span>, and warn naming what to set
              — nothing is ever guessed.
            </p>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              Quantities stay in each BOM line's own UOM — <code>bomitem.uomId</code> often
              differs from <code>part.uomId</code>, and the API takes an explicit UOM per item, so
              the BOM's own figures are never converted. A substituted flavour has no BOM line of
              its own, so it uses its part's base UOM.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div class="fb-group" style="flex:1 1 320px;">
            <div class="fb-group-title">What blocks a build</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">Create stays disabled until all of these hold:</p>
            <ul style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              <li>the note parsed with no unknown attributes and no off-scale values</li>
              <li>an active BOM exists whose finished good is this product's part</li>
              <li>every component resolved to a live part and UOM</li>
              <li>at least one component with a quantity above zero</li>
              <li>the sales order has a location group</li>
            </ul>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              Deliberately <strong>not</strong> blockers: a staged sub-assembly, a variable-quantity
              line, an optional raw good, an unmapped flavour, or a pack with no serves mapping. Each
              warns and leaves the BOM figure alone, because this report produces the ingredient list
              a person reviews before creating — not a contract that has to map perfectly.
            </p>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              <strong>Fixture rows can't post.</strong> Rows badged <span class="cs-sample">sample</span>,
              and recipes that fell back to the built-in fixtures, are refused outright.
            </p>
            <div class="fb-group-title" style="margin-top:10px;">What gets created</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">
              One <code>POST /api/manufacture-orders</code> carrying the full overridden
              <code>configurations[].items[]</code> — the finished good plus every component.
              Fishbowl generates the work orders when the MO is Issued. Nothing is ever patched
              afterwards: updating an issued MO regenerates its work orders.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    // ── Settings init ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    // The shared admin payload (the Create-MO gates) is published and read
    // through FBLib.SharedData — masterStorage: 'userProperties' below. It used
    // to go through loadReportData/saveReportData, which only work on a SAVED
    // report: the BI Script Editor previews with report id -1, so the first read
    // raised the native "Loading data is only available on reports" modal and an
    // admin publish was a silent no-op. See the FBLib.SharedData doc block.

    FBLib.Settings.init({
      masterStorage: 'userProperties',   // shared admin defaults via userproperties, not report data (which needs a SAVED report — see FBLib.SharedData)
      userKey:   'cdx.bi.customsupp.user.v1',
      masterKey: 'cdx.bi.customsupp.master.v1',
      defaults: {
        v: 1,
        expanded: false,
        showDebug: false,

        unparsedOnly: false,
        custIds: [],
        prodNums: [],
        soStatuses: [],
        sortKey: 'date',          // 'date' | 'num'
        sortDir: 'asc',           // earliest ship date first - this is a to-build queue
        dateRange: 'all',
        dateStart: '',
        dateEnd: '',
        // 'auto' runs the live query and only falls back to SAMPLE_ROWS when it
        // returns nothing, so the skeleton demos on a database with no Infinit
        // data while staying correct the moment real data lands.
        dataSource: 'auto',       // 'auto' | 'live' | 'sample'
        // Fishbowl only generates work orders when an MO is issued.
        moCreateStatus: 'Issued', // 'Issued' | 'Entered'
        // Create-MO gates (admin-published to the master payload):
        //   enableCreateMO  - master switch for the Build buttons (off by default)
        //   createMOGroupId - optional user-group restriction ('' = all users)
        //
        // enableCreateMO is the gate on the write path: until an admin turns it
        // on, nobody sees a Build button. Beyond that the create flow guards
        // itself - it always creates as Entered, verifies the moitem rows
        // against what it asked for, and DELETES the MO rather than issue one
        // that does not match. The payload is logged to the debug console on
        // every run either way.
        enableCreateMO: false,
        createMOGroupId: '',
        // THE RECIPE CONFIGURATION — the source of truth for every variable
        // quantity, deliberately SEPARATE from the Fishbowl BOM. Seeded from
        // DEFAULT_RECIPE_CONFIG below when unset; an admin publishes an edited
        // copy to the master payload (and a Setup tab will edit it in place).
        recipeConfig: null,
      },
      propFallback: {
        showDebug: { name: 'BI_SHOW_DEBUG', dflt: 'false', parse: function (v) { return v === 'true' || v === true; } }
      }
    });

    // ── Local helpers (fb-lib first, fall back if older library) ────
    var C = FBLib.Common;
    function fmtQty(v)   { try { return C.formatQty(v); }   catch (_) { var n=parseFloat(v); return isNaN(n)?'':String(n); } }
    function fmtDate(v)  { try { return C.formatDate(v); }  catch (_) { return String(v||'').slice(0,10); } }
    function escSQL(s)   { try { return C.escSQL(s); }      catch (_) { return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/'/g,"''"); } }
    function esc(s)      { return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"'); }
    function setStatus(m){ var el=document.getElementById('statusLine'); if(el) el.textContent=m; }
    function dbg(m, t)   { try { if (C.DEBUG_MODE) C.debugLog(m, t || 'info'); } catch (_) {} }

    // ── Shared v1.2 UI helpers (ported from WO_Finisher) ───────────
    function psEsc(s){ return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"'); }
    function psHexA(hex,a){
      var h=String(hex||'').replace('#','');
      if(h.length===3) h=h.split('').map(function(c){return c+c;}).join('');
      if(h.length!==6) return 'rgba(84,112,137,'+a+')';
      var r=parseInt(h.substr(0,2),16),g=parseInt(h.substr(2,2),16),b=parseInt(h.substr(4,2),16);
      return 'rgba('+r+','+g+','+b+','+a+')';
    }
    // Consolidated status pill. tone in neutral|active|success|caution|critical|blocked.
    function psSpill(tone, label, opts){
      opts = opts || {};
      var dot = opts.dot ? '<span class="dot"></span>' : '';
      var icon = opts.icon || '';
      var ttl = opts.title ? ' title="'+psEsc(opts.title)+'"' : '';
      return '<span class="spill '+tone+'"'+ttl+'>'+dot+icon+psEsc(label)+'</span>';
    }
    // Map an SO status id -> a .spill tone.
    function soStatusTone(id){
      id = Number(id);
      if (id === 60) return 'success';                                          // Fulfilled
      if (id === 25) return 'active';                                           // In Progress
      if (id === 70 || id === 80 || id === 85 || id === 90) return 'critical';   // Closed/Void/Cancelled/Expired
      return 'neutral';                                                          // Estimate / Issued
    }
    // Diagnostic line straight to the debug drawer (target of FBMfg.setDiag).
    function psDiag(msg){
      try {
        var el = document.getElementById('debugLog');
        if (!el) return;
        var div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = 'text-amber-300';
        var ts = (typeof moment === 'function') ? moment().format('HH:mm:ss.SSS') : '';
        div.textContent = (ts ? '[' + ts + '] ' : '') + '[DIAG] ' + msg;
        el.appendChild(div); el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    function showToast(message, type, duration){
      type = type || 'info'; duration = duration || 3000;
      var container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
      if (!container) { container = document.createElement('div'); container.className = 'toast-container'; document.body.appendChild(container); }
      var toast = document.createElement('div');
      toast.className = 'toast ' + type;
      var icon = type === 'success' ? '✓' : type === 'error' ? '✕' : 'ℹ';
      toast.innerHTML = '<span class="toast-icon">' + icon + '</span><span class="toast-msg"></span>';
      toast.querySelector('.toast-msg').textContent = message;
      container.appendChild(toast);
      setTimeout(function(){ toast.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(function(){ toast.remove(); }, 300); }, duration);
    }
    // Styled confirmation modal - themed replacement for confirm().
    // Returns Promise<boolean>. tone: 'warn' | 'danger' | 'info'.
    function psConfirm(opts){
      opts = opts || {};
      var title = opts.title || 'Please confirm';
      var message = opts.message || '';
      var confirmLabel = opts.confirmLabel || 'Confirm';
      var cancelLabel = opts.cancelLabel || 'Cancel';
      var tone = opts.tone || 'warn';
      return new Promise(function(resolve){
        var toneColor = tone === 'danger' ? 'var(--fb-negative)' : tone === 'info' ? 'var(--fb-blue)' : 'var(--fb-warning)';
        var toneBg = tone === 'danger' ? psHexA('#C43046', .12) : tone === 'info' ? psHexA('#2d9cdb', .12) : psHexA('#F69133', .14);
        var icon = tone === 'info'
          ? '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path stroke-linecap="round" d="M12 11v5m0-8h.01"/>'
          : '<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M10.29 3.86 1.82 18a1.5 1.5 0 0 0 1.29 2.25h17.78A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 22.18 18L13.71 3.86a1.5 1.5 0 0 0-2.42 0z"/><path stroke-linecap="round" d="M12 9v4m0 4h.01"/>';
        var scrim = document.createElement('div');
        scrim.setAttribute('style', 'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;z-index:10120;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(16,16,16,.45);padding:20px');
        scrim.innerHTML =
          '<div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" style="background:#fff;border-radius:var(--r-card);box-shadow:var(--sh3);max-width:480px;width:100%;overflow:hidden">' +
            '<div style="display:flex;gap:14px;padding:20px 20px 4px">' +
              '<div style="flex-shrink:0;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:' + toneBg + ';color:' + toneColor + ';display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center">' +
                '<svg width="22" height="22" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">' + icon + '</svg></div>' +
              '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0">' +
                '<h3 style="margin:0 0 6px;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--c-primary)">' + psEsc(title) + '</h3>' +
                '<div style="font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--c-secondary);white-space:pre-line">' + psEsc(message) + '</div>' +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;padding:16px 20px 18px">' +
              '<button type="button" class="ps-btn ps-confirm-cancel">' + psEsc(cancelLabel) + '</button>' +
              '<button type="button" class="ps-btn primary ps-confirm-ok">' + psEsc(confirmLabel) + '</button>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>';
        document.body.appendChild(scrim);
        var okBtn = scrim.querySelector('.ps-confirm-ok');
        var cancelBtn = scrim.querySelector('.ps-confirm-cancel');
        var done = false;
        function close(val){ if (done) return; done = true; document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true); scrim.remove(); resolve(val); }
        function onKey(e){ if (e.key === 'Escape'){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); close(false); } else if (e.key === 'Enter'){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); close(true); } }
        okBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ close(true); });
        cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ close(false); });
        scrim.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e){ if (e.target === scrim) close(false); });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
        setTimeout(function(){ try { okBtn.focus(); } catch (_) {} }, 30);
      });
    }

    // ── Query helper ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    function norm(r) {
      if (r == null) return [];
      if (typeof r === 'string') { try { var p = JSON.parse(r); return Array.isArray(p) ? p : []; } catch (_) { return []; } }
      return Array.isArray(r) ? r : [];
    }
    function qp(sql) {
      if (typeof runQueryAsync === 'function') {
        return runQueryAsync(sql).then(norm).catch(function (e) {
          dbg('qp fallback sync: ' + (e && e.message), 'warning');
          return norm(runQuery(sql));
        });
      }
      return Promise.resolve(norm(runQuery(sql)));
    }
    function round6(n) { return Math.round((Number(n) || 0) * 1e6) / 1e6; }

    // MySQL bit(1) does not arrive as 0/1 through this bridge — it can come
    // back as a raw byte (String.fromCharCode(0|1)), a numeric 0/1, a '0'/'1'
    // string, or a boolean, and Fishbowl's inline-script sanitiser strips
    // control characters so a raw  can vanish entirely. Decode by
    // charCode as well as by value, and never compare a bit column to a
    // literal '1'.
    function bitTrue(v) {
      if (v === true || v === 1) return true;
      if (v == null || v === false) return false;
      var s = String(v);
      if (s === '1' || s.toLowerCase() === 'true') return true;
      if (s.length === 1 && s.charCodeAt(0) === 1) return true;
      return false;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // FIXTURES
    // ----
    // Everything in this block is placeholder data for the skeleton. Each
    // entry names what replaces it. The READ path and the CREATE path are
    // real; these only stand in for Infinit's own configuration.
    // ============================================================

    // DISCOVERY - a pattern, not a list.
    //
    // An IN-list of product numbers meant a new custom SKU was invisible until
    // someone edited the report. A LIKE pattern finds it the day it is sold.
    // The trade is that a newly-discovered part has no pack mapping or step
    // config yet, which must render as blocked rather than defaulted - that is
    // handled in the drawer's preflight, not here.
    //
    // Matched against the product NUMBER and the product DESCRIPTION, OR-ed, so
    // a SKU numbered WIDGET-01 whose description says "custom" is still found.
    // The number side keeps COALESCE(p.num, si.productNum) so a line whose
    // product was deleted stays visible.
    //
    // TODO(Infinit): moves into the Setup tab's config (Stage 1/6) so a second
    // range can be added without a code change.
    //
    // The rule is: any product whose NUMBER contains CUSTOM. That covers the
    // PF-CUSTOM-75G / PF-CUSTOM-90G range and anything added to it later,
    // without this file having to be edited again.
    //
    // The description pattern is kept but DISABLED. Leaving it on would match
    // products whose number does NOT contain CUSTOM, which contradicts the
    // rule above — a SKU is either in the custom range or it is not, and the
    // number is what says so. Flip `enabled` if a description-worded range
    // ever needs picking up too.
    //
    // NOTE MySQL's default collation makes LIKE case-insensitive, so this also
    // matches a product numbered 'Custom Trailer'. A stray match is visible
    // but harmless: a product with no pack configured renders BLOCKED in the
    // drawer's preflight rather than being built with defaults.
    var DISCOVERY_PATTERNS = [
      { field: 'product.num',         op: 'LIKE', value: '%CUSTOM%', enabled: true },
      { field: 'product.description', op: 'LIKE', value: '%CUSTOM%', enabled: false }
    ];

    function activeDiscoveryPatterns() {
      return DISCOVERY_PATTERNS.filter(function (p) {
        return p && p.enabled !== false && p.value;
      });
    }
    // Human-readable form for the status line and the empty state. "No open
    // lines matched %CUSTOM%" is diagnosable; "none found" is not.
    // Which FIELDS the active patterns actually search, for the empty state.
    // Derived rather than hardcoded: the description pattern ships disabled,
    // so a fixed "number or description" would send someone hunting for a
    // match that was never looked for.
    function describeDiscoveryFields() {
      var f = activeDiscoveryPatterns().map(function (p) {
        return p.field === 'product.description' ? 'description' : 'product number';
      });
      var uniq = f.filter(function (v, i) { return f.indexOf(v) === i; });
      return uniq.join(' or ') || 'nothing';
    }

    function describeDiscovery() {
      var vals = activeDiscoveryPatterns().map(function (p) { return p.value; });
      var uniq = vals.filter(function (v, i) { return vals.indexOf(v) === i; });
      return uniq.join(' or ') || '(no pattern configured)';
    }

    // ── THE RECIPE CONFIGURATION ───────────────────────────────────
    // ONE record per pack, holding everything that pack customises. This is
    // the source of truth for every variable quantity, deliberately SEPARATE
    // from the Fishbowl BOM: the BOM supplies the fixed base ingredients and
    // the part/UOM ids, the config supplies what changes per order. Edited in
    // the report through Setup ▸ Recipe configuration (admin only) and stored
    // in the master settings payload under `recipeConfig`.
    //
    // A pack is matched to a sales-order line by the FINISHED GOOD'S PART
    // NUMBER — the part reached productId → product.partId → part.id, which is
    // also the BOM's finished good.
    //
    // Each pack holds `items`: the things a note may vary. Three mapping types:
    //
    //   scale         named levels (Low / Med / High), each with its own
    //                 quantity per pack. Level names are free text.
    //   numeric       the level IS a number with a unit (0/25/50/75/100 mg).
    //                 The label is derived from value + unit, and the bare
    //                 number parses too, so a note may say 50, 50mg or 50 mg.
    //   substitution  the level picks WHICH part fills a slot (the flavour
    //                 range). ONE quantity covers every option, because the
    //                 mass does not vary by flavour. `slotPrefix` matches the
    //                 BOM line by prefix, so a BOM built with a different
    //                 flavour still takes the customisation.
    //
    // Anything on the BOM that no item names is a FIXED base ingredient and

        Object.keys(d.levels).forEach(function (lbl) {
          levelLc[name][normKey(lbl)] = lbl;
          (d.levels[lbl].alt || []).forEach(function (a) {
            if (a) levelLc[name][normKey(a)] = lbl;
          });
        });
      });
      _vocab = { byName: byName, attrKeyLc: attrKeyLc, levelLc: levelLc };
      return _vocab;
    }
    function attributeNames() { return Object.keys(vocab().byName); }
    // For the "expected ..." message on a bad level.
    function levelListFor(key) {
      var d = vocab().byName[key];
      return d ? Object.keys(d.levels).join(' / ') : '';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // NOTE PARSING
    // ----
    // soitem.note carries the customisation as `Attribute: Level` pairs
    // separated by commas, semicolons or newlines. Nothing in this repo
    // parsed structure out of a note field before, so the contract here is
    // deliberately strict: an attribute we cannot map is SURFACED, never
    // silently dropped. A fragment with no colon is treated as prose, so an
    // ordinary shipping comment can share the field.
    // ============================================================
    function parseCustomisation(note) {
      var out = { attrs: [], unknown: [], prose: [], ok: false, empty: false, raw: '' };
      var raw = String(note == null ? '' : note).trim();
      out.raw = raw;
      if (!raw) { out.empty = true; return out; }

      raw.split(/[\r\n,;]+/).forEach(function (frag) {
        frag = frag.trim();
        if (!frag) return;
        var m = frag.match(/^([^:]+?)\s*:\s*(.+)$/);
        if (!m) { out.prose.push(frag); return; }

        var V = vocab();
        var kRaw = m[1].trim(), vRaw = m[2].trim();
        var key = V.attrKeyLc[normKey(kRaw)];
        if (!key) {
          out.unknown.push({ raw: frag, key: kRaw, level: vRaw,
            reason: 'Unknown attribute "' + kRaw + '". This range is customised on ' +
                    attributeNames().join(' / ') + ' only — everything else on ' +
                    'the BOM is a fixed base ingredient.' });
          return;
        }
        var def = V.byName[key];
        var level = (V.levelLc[key] || {})[normKey(vRaw)];
        if (!level) {
          // An OPEN attribute (flavour) accepts any level: it is carried
          // through as typed and flagged `unmapped`, which WARNS in the drawer
          // rather than blocking. A CLOSED attribute has a scale Infinit
          // specified, so anything off it is a bad note.
          if (def.openLevels) {
            out.attrs.push({ key: key, level: vRaw, raw: frag, unmapped: true });
            return;
          }
          out.unknown.push({ raw: frag, key: key, level: vRaw,
            reason: 'Unknown level "' + vRaw + '" for ' + key +
                    ' (expected ' + levelListFor(key) + ')' });
          return;
        }
        out.attrs.push({ key: key, level: level, raw: frag });
      });

      out.ok = out.attrs.length > 0 && out.unknown.length === 0;
      return out;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // RECIPE RESOLUTION
    // ----
    // base recipe + customisation -> concrete component quantities.
    //
    // The variable items take their quantity from the RECIPE CONFIGURATION,
    // not from the BOM: an absolute figure per pack which REPLACES whatever
    // the BOM line says. The base ingredients keep the BOM's own quantity.
    // Then every line is multiplied by the ordered quantity.
    //
    // Flavour additionally SUBSTITUTES the part — the config names which
    // FLV-RTU-* raw good fills the slot, and its part and UOM ids come from
    // the part lookup in ctx.partIndex.
    //
    // Nothing here can BLOCK a build. Anything the report cannot apply — a
    // pack with no recipe config, a level with no configured quantity, an
    // unmapped flavour, a substitution target that is not in Fishbowl — comes
    // back as a WARNING with the BOM figure left alone. The resolved list is
    // the basis for a work order a person reviews, not a contract that has to
    // map perfectly.
    // ============================================================
    function resolveRecipe(recipe, orderQty, attrs, ctx) {
      var warnings = [];
      if (!recipe) return { lines: [], warnings: ['No base recipe available.'] };

      ctx = ctx || {};
      var qty = Number(orderQty) || 0;
      var outputQty = Number(recipe.outputQty) || 1;
      var fgPartNum = ctx.fgPartNum || '';
      var partIndex = ctx.partIndex || {};
      var pack = packRecipe(fgPartNum);
      var serves = servesPerPack(fgPartNum);
      var matched = {};   // index of every attribute that found a BOM line

      if (!pack && (attrs || []).length) {
        warnings.push('There is no recipe configuration for pack "' + (fgPartNum || '?') +
          '", so every customised quantity falls back to the BOM figure. Add the pack to the ' +
          'recipe configuration.');
      }

      // Resolve each note attribute against the ACTUAL recipe lines, using
      // THIS PACK'S item for both the target part and the quantity — two packs
      // may legitimately use different parts for the same attribute, so the
      // merged vocabulary is only used for parsing.
      function adjsFor(line) {
        var out = [];
        (attrs || []).forEach(function (a, ai) {
          var it = packItem(pack, a.key);
          if (!it || !itemTargetsLine(it, line)) return;
          matched[ai] = 1;
          var lvl = itemLevel(it, a.level);
          out.push({
            attr: a.key, level: a.level,
            kind: (String(it.type) === 'substitution') ? 'substitution' : 'quantity',
            perServe: (lvl && lvl.perServe) || '',
            part: (lvl && lvl.partNum) || '',
            qty: lvl ? configQty(pack, a.key, a.level) : null,
            unmapped: !lvl || !!a.unmapped,
            applied: false, fromPart: ''
          });
        });
        return out;
      }

      var lines = recipe.lines.map(function (l) {
        var basePerUnit = (Number(l.qty) || 0) / outputQty;
        var adjs = adjsFor(l);
        var perUnit = basePerUnit;
        var partNum = l.partNum, partId = l.partId != null ? l.partId : null;
        var uom = l.uom || '', uomId = l.uomId != null ? l.uomId : null;
        var label = l.partNum || l.desc || 'the component';
        var fromConfig = false;

        adjs.forEach(function (a) {
          // 1. SUBSTITUTION — which part fills the slot. Never a quantity.
          if (a.kind === 'substitution' && a.part) {
            var same = String(a.part).toUpperCase() === String(partNum || '').toUpperCase();
            var tgt = partIndex[String(a.part).toUpperCase()];
            if (same) {
              a.applied = true;                       // already the right part
            } else if (tgt && tgt.partId != null && tgt.uomId != null) {
              a.fromPart = partNum;
              partNum = tgt.partNum; partId = tgt.partId;
              uom = tgt.uom || uom; uomId = tgt.uomId;
              a.applied = true;
              if (tgt.active === false) {
                warnings.push(a.attr + ' "' + a.level + '" resolves to ' + tgt.partNum +
                  ', which is an INACTIVE part.');
              }
            } else {
              warnings.push(a.attr + ' "' + a.level + '" needs part ' + a.part +
                ', which is not in Fishbowl — the BOM\u2019s ' + label + ' is kept, so swap it ' +
                'by hand on the work order.');
            }
          }
          // 2. QUANTITY — an absolute figure per pack from the recipe config,
          //    REPLACING the BOM's own quantity for this line.
          if (a.qty != null) { perUnit = a.qty; a.applied = true; fromConfig = true; }
        });

        // Whatever could not be applied, named individually so the operator
        // knows exactly which figure to set and where to fix it.
        adjs.forEach(function (a) {
          if (a.unmapped) {
            warnings.push(a.attr + ' "' + a.level + '" is not mapped to a part, so ' + label +
              ' is left exactly as the BOM has it — check it is the right ' +
              a.attr.toLowerCase() + ' before creating.');
            return;
          }
          if (a.qty == null) {
            warnings.push(a.attr + ' "' + a.level + '" has no quantity in the recipe ' +
              'configuration for pack "' + (fgPartNum || '?') + '", so ' + label +
              ' keeps its BOM figure of ' + fmtQty(basePerUnit) + ' ' + (l.uom || '') +
              ' — add the value to the configuration.');
          }
        });

        // A variable-quantity BOM line the config did NOT set: the BOM figure
        // is explicitly only a default, so say so. Silent when the config
        // supplied the figure, which is the normal case for a variable item.
        if (l.variableQty && !fromConfig) {
          warnings.push('Component "' + label + '" is a variable-quantity BOM line, so its ' +
            fmtQty(basePerUnit) + ' ' + (l.uom || '') + ' is only a default and nothing in the ' +
            'recipe configuration replaced it — set the quantity you actually want.');
        }

        if (perUnit < 0) {
          warnings.push('The recipe configuration drove ' + label + ' below zero (' +
            round6(perUnit) + '); clamped to 0.');
          perUnit = 0;
        }
        var finalQty = round6(perUnit * qty);
        if (adjs.length && finalQty === 0) {
          warnings.push(label + ' resolves to zero and will be omitted from the order.');
        }

        return {
          partNum: partNum, partId: partId,
          desc: l.desc || partNum,
          uom: uom, uomId: uomId,
          // The part the BOM carried, kept so a substitution is visible.
          bomPartNum: l.partNum,
          isFg: !!l.isFg, stage: !!l.stage, stageBomId: l.stageBomId || null,
          variableQty: !!l.variableQty,
          basePerUnit: round6(basePerUnit),
          adjs: adjs,
          // true when the per-pack figure came from the recipe config rather
          // than the BOM — surfaced in the drawer so the source is never
          // ambiguous.
          fromConfig: fromConfig,
          serves: serves,
          perUnit: round6(perUnit),
          finalQty: finalQty,
          userQty: null,     // operator override, null = use finalQty
          dirty: false
        };
      });

      // An attribute that matched NO line is a real configuration mismatch —
      // the customer asked to vary something this recipe does not contain — so
      // surface it rather than ignoring it. Still a warning, not a blocker.
      (attrs || []).forEach(function (a, ai) {
        if (matched[ai] || !pack) return;   // the pack-level warning covers !pack
        var it = packItem(pack, a.key);
        if (!it) {
          warnings.push('Customisation "' + a.key + ': ' + a.level + '" is not an item in the ' +
            'recipe configuration for pack "' + (fgPartNum || '?') + '", so nothing was ' +
            'changed. Add it in Setup, or correct the note.');
          return;
        }
        var target = it.slotPrefix ? ('a ' + it.slotPrefix + '* line') :
                     (it.partNum ? ('"' + it.partNum + '"') : 'a component');
        warnings.push('Customisation "' + a.key + ': ' + a.level + '" targets ' + target +
          ', which is not in the base recipe.');
      });

      return { lines: lines, warnings: warnings };
    }

    // Effective quantity for a component line: the operator's override when
    // present, else the resolved value. Mirrors FBMfg.effectiveUsedQty's
    // input-else-target contract so overrides behave the same as in the
    // finish drawer.
    function effectiveQty(line) {
      if (line.userQty !== null && line.userQty !== '' && isFinite(Number(line.userQty))) {
        return round6(Number(line.userQty));
      }
      return round6(line.finalQty);
    }

    // ── State ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    var state = {
      rows: [],            // flat line rows (live or sample), each with ._parsed
      orders: [],          // grouped: [{ so_id, so_num, ..., lines: [] }]
      source: 'live',      // where state.rows actually came from
      customers: [],       // [{id,name}] for the filter
      products: [],        // [{id,name}] (id = product num)
      soStatusList: [],
      // Parts named by the recipe config (flavour options, the electrolyte and
      // caffeine components), resolved to live ids once at load so a
      // substitution can actually be posted. Keyed by UPPERCASE part number.
      configParts: {},
      expandedSOs: new Set(),
      custIds: new Set(),
      prodNums: new Set(),
      soStat: new Set(),
      hideBuilt: false,
      unparsedOnly: false,
      search: '',
      sortKey: 'date',
      sortDir: 'asc',
      dateRange: 'all',
      dateStart: '',
      dateEnd: '',
      kpis: {}
    };

    // ============================================================
    // MULTI-SELECT (lightweight; mirrors WO_Finisher / WO_Parts_Availability)
    // Selections are Sets held on `state` - mutate with .clear()/.add(),
    // never reassign, or the closures below go stale.
    // ============================================================
    var MS = (function () {
      var open = null;
      var configs = {
        cust:   { state: 'custIds',  listEl: 'custList',   triggerEl: 'custTrigger',   dropdownEl: 'custDropdown',   placeholder: 'All',      items: function(){ return state.customers.map(function(x){ return {id:String(x.id), label:x.name}; }); } },
        prod:   { state: 'prodNums', listEl: 'prodList',   triggerEl: 'prodTrigger',   dropdownEl: 'prodDropdown',   placeholder: 'All',      items: function(){ return state.products.map(function(x){ return {id:String(x.id), label:x.name}; }); } },
        sostat: { state: 'soStat',   listEl: 'sostatList', triggerEl: 'sostatTrigger', dropdownEl: 'sostatDropdown', placeholder: 'All open', items: function(){ return state.soStatusList.map(function(x){ return {id:String(x.id), label:x.name}; }); } }
      };

      function toggle(key, ev) {
        if (ev) ev.stopPropagation();
        if (open && open !== key) { closeAll(); }
        var dd = document.getElementById(configs[key].dropdownEl);
        if (!dd) return;
        if (dd.classList.contains('hidden')) {
          dd.classList.remove('hidden'); open = key; renderList(key, '');
        } else { dd.classList.add('hidden'); open = null; }
      }
      function closeAll() {
        Object.keys(configs).forEach(function (k) {
          var dd = document.getElementById(configs[k].dropdownEl);
          if (dd) dd.classList.add('hidden');
        });
        open = null;
      }
      document.addEventListener('click', function () { closeAll(); });

      function selSet(key) { return state[configs[key].state]; }
      function renderTrigger(key) {
        var trig = document.getElementById(configs[key].triggerEl);
        if (!trig) return;
        var sel = selSet(key); var items = configs[key].items();
        if (sel.size === 0) {
          trig.innerHTML = '<span class="ms-placeholder">' + esc(configs[key].placeholder) + '</span>';
          return;
        }
        var picked = items.filter(function (it) { return sel.has(it.id); });
        var tags = picked.slice(0, 3).map(function (it) {
          return '<span class="ms-tag">' + esc(it.label) + '<span class="ms-tag-x" onclick="event.stopPropagation();MS.remove(\'' + key + '\',\'' + String(it.id).replace(/'/g,''') + '\')">×</span></span>';
        }).join('');
        if (picked.length > 3) tags += '<span class="ms-tag">+' + (picked.length - 3) + '</span>';
        trig.innerHTML = tags;
      }
      function renderList(key, search) {
        var listEl = document.getElementById(configs[key].listEl);
        if (!listEl) return;
        var items = configs[key].items();
        var s = (search || '').toLowerCase();
        if (s) items = items.filter(function (it) { return it.label.toLowerCase().indexOf(s) !== -1; });
        if (!items.length) { listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="ms-empty">No matches</div>'; return; }
        var sel = selSet(key);
        listEl.innerHTML = items.map(function (it) {
          var checked = sel.has(it.id) ? 'checked' : '';
          return '<label class="ms-item"><input type="checkbox" ' + checked + ' onchange="MS.toggleItem(\'' + key + '\',\'' + String(it.id).replace(/'/g,''') + '\')">' + esc(it.label) + '</label>';
        }).join('');
      }
      function toggleItem(key, id) {
        var sel = selSet(key);
        if (sel.has(id)) sel.delete(id); else sel.add(id);
        renderTrigger(key); persist(); afterFilterChange(key);
      }
      function remove(key, id)   { selSet(key).delete(id); renderTrigger(key); persist(); afterFilterChange(key); }
      function selectAll(key)    { var sel = selSet(key); configs[key].items().forEach(function (it) { sel.add(it.id); }); renderTrigger(key); renderList(key, ''); persist(); afterFilterChange(key); }
      function clear(key)        { selSet(key).clear(); renderTrigger(key); renderList(key, ''); persist(); afterFilterChange(key); }
      function search(key, v)    { renderList(key, v); }

      // Customer + product narrow the SQL, so they re-query. SO status is
      // applied client-side off the same snapshot.
      function afterFilterChange(key) {
        if (key === 'sostat') { render(); return; }
        loadAll();
      }

      function persist() {
        try {
          FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('custIds',    Array.from(state.custIds));
          FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('prodNums',   Array.from(state.prodNums));
          FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('soStatuses', Array.from(state.soStat).map(Number));
          FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      function renderAll() { Object.keys(configs).forEach(renderTrigger); }

      return { toggle: toggle, closeAll: closeAll, toggleItem: toggleItem, remove: remove,
               selectAll: selectAll, clear: clear, search: search, renderAll: renderAll };
    })();
    window.MS = MS;

    // ============================================================
    // REFERENCE DATA
    // ============================================================
    var SO_STATUS_FALLBACK = [
      { id: 10, name: 'Estimate' }, { id: 20, name: 'Issued' }, { id: 25, name: 'In Progress' },
      { id: 60, name: 'Fulfilled' }, { id: 70, name: 'Closed Short' }, { id: 80, name: 'Voided' },
      { id: 85, name: 'Cancelled' }, { id: 90, name: 'Expired' }
    ];
    var soStatusName = {};

    // Every part number the recipe config can name. A substitution target must
    // resolve to a live part.id AND uom.id before it can be posted, and these
    // parts are NOT necessarily on the BOM — the whole point of the config is
    // that it can name a flavour the base BOM does not carry.
    function configPartNums() {
      var out = {};
      packsOf(recipeConfig()).forEach(function (pk) {
        (pk.items || []).forEach(function (it) {
          if (it.partNum) out[String(it.partNum).toUpperCase()] = 1;
          (it.levels || []).forEach(function (lv) {
            if (lv && lv.partNum) out[String(lv.partNum).toUpperCase()] = 1;
          });
        });
      });
      return Object.keys(out);
    }

    function loadConfigParts() {
      var nums = configPartNums();
      state.configParts = {};
      if (!nums.length) return Promise.resolve();
      // NOTE part.uomId is the PART's base UOM. A substituted part has no
      // bomitem row of its own, so its base UOM is the only honest choice —
      // unlike a BOM line, whose own uomId is used verbatim.
      var sql = [
        'SELECT part.id AS partid, part.num AS partnum, part.uomid AS uomid,',
        '       u.code AS uomcode, (COALESCE(part.activeflag, 0) + 0) AS partactive',
        'FROM part',
        'LEFT JOIN uom u ON u.id = part.uomid',
        'WHERE part.num IN (' + nums.map(function (n) {
          return "'" + escSQL(n) + "'";
        }).join(',') + ')'
      ].join('\n');
      return qp(sql).then(function (rows) {
        var idx = {};
        (rows || []).forEach(function (r) {
          var pn = String(r.partnum == null ? '' : r.partnum);
          if (!pn) return;
          idx[pn.toUpperCase()] = {
            partNum: pn,
            partId: r.partid != null ? r.partid : null,
            uomId: r.uomid != null ? r.uomid : null,
            uom: r.uomcode || '',
            active: bitTrue(r.partactive)
          };
        });
        state.configParts = idx;
        dbg('Recipe-config parts resolved: ' + Object.keys(idx).length + ' of ' + nums.length, 'info');
      }).catch(function (e) {
        dbg('Recipe-config part lookup failed: ' + (e && e.message), 'warning');
        state.configParts = {};
      });
    }

    function loadReferenceData() {
      return qp('SELECT id, name FROM sostatus ORDER BY id')
        .then(function (rows) {
          state.soStatusList = (rows && rows.length)
            ? rows.map(function (r) { return { id: r.id, name: (r.name || '').trim() || String(r.id) }; })
            : SO_STATUS_FALLBACK.slice();
        })
        .catch(function () { state.soStatusList = SO_STATUS_FALLBACK.slice(); })
        .then(function () {
          soStatusName = {};
          state.soStatusList.forEach(function (s) { soStatusName[String(s.id)] = s.name; });
          // The product filter is derived from whatever discovery returned - see
          // adoptRows. Seeding it from a static list here would offer products
          // that the pattern never finds.
        })
        .then(loadConfigParts);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // DATE-RANGE FILTER
    // Resolves the chip-strip selector into ISO YYYY-MM-DD bounds for the SQL
    // filter. Uses moment so bounds are honest to local tz (DB datetimes are
    // server-local). Nulls mean unbounded on that side.
    // ============================================================
    function resolveDateRange() {
      var v = state.dateRange || 'all';
      if (v === 'all') return { start: null, end: null };
      var now = (typeof moment === 'function') ? moment() : null;
      if (!now) return { start: state.dateStart || null, end: state.dateEnd || null };
      switch (v) {
        case 'overdue':   return { start: null, end: now.clone().subtract(1, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
        case 'today':     return { start: now.clone().format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: now.clone().format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
        case 'next7':     return { start: now.clone().format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: now.clone().add(7, 'days').format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
        case 'next30':    return { start: now.clone().format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: now.clone().add(30, 'days').format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
        case 'thisMonth': return { start: now.clone().startOf('month').format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: now.clone().endOf('month').format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
        case 'custom':    return { start: state.dateStart || null, end: state.dateEnd || null };
      }
      return { start: null, end: null };
    }

    // ============================================================
    // MAIN LOAD
    // ----
    // One query. soitem has NO partId, so the part is reached
    // productId -> product.partId -> part.id, and product.partId is nullable -
    // hence the LEFT joins and the "part not resolved" blocker rather than a
    // crash. COALESCE(product.num, soitem.productNum) keeps lines whose product
    // was deleted visible (productNum is NOT NULL and denormalised).
    // ============================================================
    function buildSQL() {
      var where = [];
      // typeId 10 = Sale, 12 = Drop Ship - the stock-driving line types.
      where.push('si.typeId IN (10, 12)');
      // Never list finished/void/cancelled orders - this is a to-build queue.
      where.push('so.statusId IN (10, 20, 25)');

      // Pattern discovery. OR-ed across the configured patterns, wrapped in its
      // own parens so it can't bind loosely against the AND-ed conditions.
      var pats = activeDiscoveryPatterns();
      if (!pats.length) return null;
      where.push('(' + pats.map(function (p) {
        var col = (p.field === 'product.description')
          ? 'p.description'
          : 'COALESCE(p.num, si.productNum)';
        return col + " LIKE '" + escSQL(p.value) + "'";
      }).join(' OR ') + ')');

      // The product filter NARROWS the pattern - it is an additional AND, not a
      // replacement for it. (It used to replace the list, which silently
      // defeated discovery the moment anyone touched the dropdown.)
      if (state.prodNums.size) {
        where.push('COALESCE(p.num, si.productNum) IN (' +
          Array.from(state.prodNums).map(function (n) { return "'" + escSQL(n) + "'"; }).join(',') + ')');
      }

      if (state.custIds.size) {
        where.push('so.customerId IN (' + Array.from(state.custIds).map(Number)
          .filter(function (n) { return !isNaN(n); }).join(',') + ')');
      }

      var dr = resolveDateRange();
      if (dr.start) where.push("so.dateFirstShip >= '" + escSQL(dr.start) + " 00:00:00'");
      if (dr.end)   where.push("so.dateFirstShip <= '" + escSQL(dr.end)   + " 23:59:59'");

      var order = (state.sortKey === 'num')
        ? 'so.num ' + (state.sortDir === 'asc' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC') + ', si.soLineItem ASC'
        : 'so.dateFirstShip ' + (state.sortDir === 'asc' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC') + ', so.num ASC, si.soLineItem ASC';

      return [
        'SELECT so.id AS so_id, so.num AS so_num, so.statusId AS so_status,',
        '       so.dateFirstShip AS ship_date, so.locationGroupId AS locationgroupid,',
        '       so.customerId AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name,',
        '       si.id AS soitem_id, si.soLineItem AS line_num, si.note AS note,',
        '       si.qtyOrdered AS qty_ordered, si.qtyFulfilled AS qty_fulfilled,',
        '       si.statusId AS line_status, si.description AS line_desc,',
        '       COALESCE(p.num, si.productNum) AS product_num,',
        '       si.uomId AS uom_id, u.code AS uom_code,',
        '       pt.id AS part_id, pt.num AS part_num,',
        '       mi.moId AS existing_mo_id, mo.num AS existing_mo_num',
        'FROM soitem si',
        'INNER JOIN so ON so.id = si.soId',
        'LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id = so.customerId',
        'LEFT JOIN product p  ON p.id = si.productId',
        'LEFT JOIN part pt    ON pt.id = p.partId',
        'LEFT JOIN uom u      ON u.id = si.uomId',
        // moitem.soItemId is how Fishbowl links a build back to the SO line -
        // this drives the "Existing MO" column and the duplicate-build guard.
        'LEFT JOIN moitem mi  ON mi.soItemId = si.id',
        'LEFT JOIN mo         ON mo.id = mi.moId',
        'WHERE ' + where.join(' AND '),
        'ORDER BY ' + order,
        'LIMIT 1000'
      ].join('\n');
    }

    function loadAll() {
      var src = FBLib.Settings.resolve('dataSource') || 'auto';
      showSpinner(true, 'Loading custom supplement lines…');
      setStatus('Loading…');

      if (src === 'sample') {
        adoptRows(SAMPLE_ROWS.slice(), 'sample');
        showSpinner(false);
        return Promise.resolve();
      }

      var sql = buildSQL();
      if (!sql) { adoptRows([], 'live'); showSpinner(false); return Promise.resolve(); }
      dbg('Main query:\n' + sql, 'query');

      return qp(sql).then(function (rows) {
        rows = rows || [];
        if (!rows.length && src === 'auto') {
          dbg('Live query returned 0 rows - falling back to sample fixtures.', 'warning');
          adoptRows(SAMPLE_ROWS.slice(), 'sample');
        } else {
          adoptRows(rows, 'live');
        }
        showSpinner(false);
      }).catch(function (e) {
        dbg('Main query failed: ' + (e && e.message), 'error');
        if (src === 'auto') {
          adoptRows(SAMPLE_ROWS.slice(), 'sample');
          setStatus('Live query failed — showing sample data. ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : ''));
        } else {
          adoptRows([], 'live');
          setStatus('Query failed: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e));
          showToast('Query failed — see the debug console', 'error', 5000);
        }
        showSpinner(false);
      });
    }

    // Parse, group and paint. One path for both live and sample rows.
    function adoptRows(rows, source) {
      state.source = source;
      state.rows = rows.map(function (r) {
        var row = Object.assign({}, r);
        row._sample = (source === 'sample');
        row._key = String(row.soitem_id);
        row._parsed = parseCustomisation(row.note);
        row._hasMo = !!(row.existing_mo_id || row.existing_mo_num);
        return row;
      });

      // Customer filter options come from whatever the query returned, so the
      // list can never offer a customer with no custom lines.
      var seen = {};
      state.customers = [];
      state.rows.forEach(function (r) {
        var id = r.customer_id != null ? r.customer_id : ('n:' + (r.customer_name || ''));
        if (seen[id]) return;
        seen[id] = 1;
        state.customers.push({ id: id, name: (r.customer_name || '(no customer)') });
      });
      state.customers.sort(function (a, b) { return String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name)); });

      // Product filter options, derived the same way. Keeps the dropdown honest:
      // it can only ever offer products the discovery pattern actually matched.
      // Selecting one narrows the pattern rather than replacing it, so an
      // untouched dropdown and pattern-only discovery agree.
      var seenProd = {};
      state.products = [];
      state.rows.forEach(function (r) {
        var num = r.product_num || '';
        if (!num || seenProd[num]) return;
        seenProd[num] = 1;
        state.products.push({ id: num, name: num });
      });
      state.products.sort(function (a, b) {
        return String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name), undefined, { numeric: true });
      });
      // Drop any persisted product selection that this result set can't offer,
      // or the filter would silently exclude everything.
      Array.from(state.prodNums).forEach(function (p) {
        if (!seenProd[p]) state.prodNums.delete(p);
      });

      groupRows();
      computeKpis();
      renderKpis();
      MS.renderAll();
      render();

      var n = state.rows.length;
      var note = (source === 'sample')
