        ? ' — SAMPLE fixtures (nothing matched ' + describeDiscovery() + '); builds are disabled'
        : ' — matched ' + describeDiscovery();
      setStatus(n + ' custom line' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' across ' +
        state.orders.length + ' order' + (state.orders.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + note);
    }

    function groupRows() {
      var byOrder = {};
      var order = [];
      state.rows.forEach(function (r) {
        var k = String(r.so_id);
        if (!byOrder[k]) {
          byOrder[k] = {
            so_id: r.so_id, so_num: r.so_num, so_status: r.so_status,
            ship_date: r.ship_date, customer_name: r.customer_name,
            customer_id: r.customer_id, locationgroupid: r.locationgroupid,
            _sample: r._sample, lines: []
          };
          order.push(byOrder[k]);
        }
        byOrder[k].lines.push(r);
      });
      state.orders = order;
      // First paint: honour "expand all by default".
      if (FBLib.Settings.resolve('expanded')) {
        state.orders.forEach(function (o) { state.expandedSOs.add(String(o.so_id)); });
      }
    }

    // ── Client-side filters (search / SO status / hide-built / unparsed) ──
    function visibleLines(o) {
      var s = (state.search || '').toLowerCase();
      return o.lines.filter(function (r) {
        if (state.hideBuilt && r._hasMo) return false;
        if (state.unparsedOnly && r._parsed.ok) return false;
        if (state.soStat.size && !state.soStat.has(String(r.so_status))) return false;
        if (s) {
          var hay = [r.so_num, r.customer_name, r.product_num, r.line_desc, r.note,
                     r.existing_mo_num].join(' ').toLowerCase();
          if (hay.indexOf(s) === -1) return false;
        }
        return true;
      });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // KPIs
    // ============================================================
    function computeKpis() {
      var k = { orders: 0, lines: 0, units: 0, ready: 0, unparsed: 0, built: 0, customers: 0 };
      var custs = {};
      state.orders.forEach(function (o) {
        var lines = visibleLines(o);
        if (!lines.length) return;
        k.orders++;
        custs[String(o.customer_id)] = 1;
        lines.forEach(function (r) {
          k.lines++;
          k.units += Number(r.qty_ordered) || 0;
          if (r._hasMo) k.built++;
          if (r._parsed.ok) k.ready++;
          else k.unparsed++;
        });
      });
      k.customers = Object.keys(custs).length;
      state.kpis = k;
    }

    function setKpi(id, value, sub) {
      var tile = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!tile) return;
      var numEl = tile.querySelector('.kpi-num');
      if (numEl) numEl.textContent = value;
      if (sub != null) {
        var subEl = document.getElementById(id + 'Sub');
        if (subEl) subEl.textContent = sub;
      }
    }

    function renderKpis() {
      var k = state.kpis || {};
      setKpi('kpiOrders',   String(k.orders || 0), (k.customers || 0) + ' customer' + ((k.customers === 1) ? '' : 's'));
      setKpi('kpiLines',    String(k.lines || 0),  state.source === 'sample' ? 'sample data' : 'live');
      setKpi('kpiUnits',    fmtQty(k.units || 0));
      setKpi('kpiReady',    String(k.ready || 0));
      setKpi('kpiUnparsed', String(k.unparsed || 0));
      setKpi('kpiBuilt',    String(k.built || 0));
    }

    // ============================================================
    // RENDER
    // ============================================================
    var COLSPAN = 9;

    function chipsHtml(parsed) {
      if (parsed.empty) return '<span class="cs-chip none">no note</span>';
      var out = parsed.attrs.map(function (a) {
        // `unmapped` is an accepted level with no part behind it yet (an
        // open-vocabulary flavour). Amber like an unknown attribute, because
        // it needs attention — but a pencil, not a warning triangle, because
        // it does NOT block the build.
        if (a.unmapped) {
          return '<span class="cs-chip unmapped" title="' +
            esc(a.key + ' "' + a.level + '" is not mapped to a part yet — the BOM line is kept ' +
                'as-is and must be swapped by hand on the work order.') + '">✎ <span class="k">' +
            esc(a.key) + '</span>' + esc(a.level) + '</span>';
        }
        return '<span class="cs-chip"><span class="k">' + esc(a.key) + '</span>' + esc(a.level) + '</span>';
      });
      parsed.unknown.forEach(function (u) {
        out.push('<span class="cs-chip unknown" title="' + esc(u.reason) + '">⚠ ' +
          esc(u.key) + ': ' + esc(u.level) + '</span>');
      });
      if (!out.length) return '<span class="cs-chip none">no attributes</span>';
      return '<span class="cs-chips">' + out.join('') + '</span>';
    }

    function readinessSpill(r) {
      if (r._sample)          return psSpill('blocked', 'Sample',  { title: 'Sample fixture row — cannot create a real MO.' });
      if (r._parsed.empty)    return psSpill('caution', 'No note', { title: 'This line has no customisation note, so there is nothing to resolve.' });
      if (r._parsed.unknown.length) {
        return psSpill('caution', 'Unparsed', { title: r._parsed.unknown.map(function (u) { return u.reason; }).join('\n') });
      }
      if (r._hasMo)           return psSpill('success', 'Built',   { title: 'MO ' + (r.existing_mo_num || r.existing_mo_id) + ' is already linked to this SO line.' });
      return psSpill('active', 'Ready', { title: 'Note parsed cleanly — open the drawer to resolve the recipe.' });
    }

    function render() {
      var tbody = document.getElementById('csBody');
      if (!tbody) return;

      // Filters may have changed what counts, so KPIs ride along with render.
      computeKpis();
      renderKpis();

      var canBuild = csCreateAllowed();
      var html = [];
      var shown = 0;

      state.orders.forEach(function (o) {
        var lines = visibleLines(o);
        if (!lines.length) return;
        shown++;

        var expanded = state.expandedSOs.has(String(o.so_id));
        var units = lines.reduce(function (a, r) { return a + (Number(r.qty_ordered) || 0); }, 0);
        var bad = lines.filter(function (r) { return !r._parsed.ok; }).length;

        // One MO covers the whole order, so the Build action lives HERE, on the
        // order — not on each line. Each custom line becomes a configuration
        // and, on issue, its own work order.
        var buildBtn = '';
        if (canBuild) {
          var buildable = lines.filter(function (r) { return r._parsed.ok && !r._sample && !r._hasMo; });
          var soDisabled = !buildable.length;
          var soReason = !lines.length ? 'No custom lines on this order.'
            : (lines.every(function (r) { return r._hasMo; })
                ? 'Every custom line on this order already has an MO.'
                : (lines.some(function (r) { return r._sample; })
                    ? 'Sample fixture order — its parts do not exist in the database.'
                    : 'No line on this order has a parsable note yet.'));
          buildBtn = '<button class="ps-btn sm ' + (soDisabled ? '' : 'primary ') + 'row-build"' +
            (soDisabled ? ' disabled title="' + esc(soReason) + '"'
                        : ' title="Resolve every custom line and create one MO for this order"') +
            ' onclick="event.stopPropagation();CSBuild.open(\'' + esc(o.so_id) + '\')">' +
            '<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">' +
            '<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M11.42 15.17 17.25 21A2.652 2.652 0 0 0 21 17.25l-5.877-5.877M11.42 15.17l2.496-3.03c.317-.384.74-.626 1.208-.766M11.42 15.17l-4.655 5.653a2.548 2.548 0 1 1-3.586-3.586l6.837-5.63m5.108-.233c.55-.164 1.163-.188 1.743-.14a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 4.486-6.336l-3.276 3.277a3.004 3.004 0 0 1-2.25-2.25l3.276-3.276a4.5 4.5 0 0 0-6.336 4.486c.091 1.076-.071 2.264-.904 2.95l-.102.085m-1.745 1.437L5.909 7.5H4.5L2.25 3.75l1.5-1.5L7.5 4.5v1.409l4.26 4.26m-1.745 1.437 1.745-1.437m6.615 8.206L15.75 15.75M4.867 19.125h.008v.008h-.008v-.008Z"/></svg>' +
            (soDisabled ? '' : 'Build MO') + '</button>';
        }

        html.push(
          '<tr class="so-row' + (expanded ? ' expanded' : '') + '" data-soid="' + esc(o.so_id) + '">' +
            '<td>' + esc(fmtDate(o.ship_date)) + '</td>' +
            '<td>' +
              '<span class="twisty" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleSO(\'' + esc(o.so_id) + '\')">▶</span>' +
              '<a class="row-link" href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();openSO(\'' +
                 esc(String(o.so_num).replace(/'/g, ''')) + '\')">' + esc(o.so_num) + '</a>' +
              (o._sample ? '<span class="cs-sample">sample</span>' : '') +
            '</td>' +
            '<td>' + esc(o.customer_name || '—') + '</td>' +
            '<td>' + (bad ? psSpill('caution', bad + ' need attention') : psSpill('neutral', lines.length + ' line' + (lines.length === 1 ? '' : 's'))) + '</td>' +
            '<td class="nr">' + esc(fmtQty(units)) + '</td>' +
            '<td></td>' +
            '<td>' + psSpill(soStatusTone(o.so_status), soStatusName[String(o.so_status)] || ('status ' + o.so_status)) + '</td>' +
            '<td></td>' +
            '<td>' + buildBtn + '</td>' +
          '</tr>'
        );

        lines.forEach(function (r) {
          // No per-line Build button: the MO is created for the whole order
          // from the SO row above. The line's own readiness still shows in the
          // Status column, and the reason on hover when it isn't buildable.
          var lineNote = r._parsed.ok && !r._sample && !r._hasMo
            ? ''
            : '<span class="muted" title="' + esc(buildDisabledReason(r)) + '" ' +
              'style="font-size:10px;cursor:help">' +
              (r._hasMo ? 'built' : 'not buildable') + '</span>';

          html.push(
            '<tr class="line-row' + (expanded ? '' : ' collapsed') + '" data-soid="' + esc(o.so_id) + '" data-key="' + esc(r._key) + '">' +
              '<td class="muted">' + esc(fmtDate(r.ship_date)) + '</td>' +
              '<td class="indent"><span class="muted">line</span> <strong>' + esc(r.line_num) + '</strong></td>' +
              '<td><strong>' + esc(r.product_num || '—') + '</strong>' +
                  (r.line_desc ? '<div class="muted" style="font-size:10.5px">' + esc(r.line_desc) + '</div>' : '') + '</td>' +
              '<td>' + chipsHtml(r._parsed) +
                  (r._parsed.prose.length ? '<div class="muted" style="font-size:10px;margin-top:2px" title="' +
                     esc(r._parsed.prose.join(' | ')) + '">+ ' + r._parsed.prose.length + ' prose line' +
                     (r._parsed.prose.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + '</div>' : '') + '</td>' +
              '<td class="nr">' + esc(fmtQty(r.qty_ordered)) + '</td>' +
              '<td class="muted">' + esc(r.uom_code || '—') + '</td>' +
              '<td>' + readinessSpill(r) + '</td>' +
              '<td>' + (r._hasMo
                  ? '<a class="row-link" href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();openMO(\'' +
                    esc(String(r.existing_mo_num || '').replace(/'/g, ''')) + '\')">' +
                    esc(r.existing_mo_num || r.existing_mo_id) + '</a>'
                  : '<span class="muted">—</span>') + '</td>' +
              '<td>' + lineNote + '</td>' +
            '</tr>'
          );
        });
      });

      if (!shown) {
        // Name the pattern AND the field. "No open lines matched %CUSTOM% on the
        // product number" tells you where to look; "no lines found" does not.
        var msg = state.rows.length
          ? 'No lines match the current filters.'
          : 'No open sales-order lines matched ' + describeDiscovery() +
            ' on the ' + describeDiscoveryFields() + '. Check the product exists and is on an ' +
            'open order (Estimate / Issued / In Progress), widen the pattern in DISCOVERY_PATTERNS, ' +
            'or switch the data source to Sample in Settings.';
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="' + COLSPAN + '" class="empty">' + esc(msg) + '</td></tr>';
        return;
      }
      tbody.innerHTML = html.join('');
    }

    function buildDisabledReason(r) {
      if (r._sample) return 'Sample fixture row — its parts do not exist in the database, so no MO can be created.';
      if (r._parsed.empty) return 'This line has no customisation note.';
      if (r._parsed.unknown.length) return r._parsed.unknown.map(function (u) { return u.reason; }).join('\n');
      return 'Not buildable.';
    }

    window.toggleSO = function (soId) {
      var key = String(soId);
      if (state.expandedSOs.has(key)) state.expandedSOs.delete(key);
      else state.expandedSOs.add(key);
      render();
    };

    window.openSO = function (num) { try { openModule('Sales Order', num); } catch (e) { dbg('openSO: ' + (e && e.message), 'error'); } };
    window.openMO = function (num) { try { openModule('Manufacture Order', num); } catch (e) { dbg('openMO: ' + (e && e.message), 'error'); } };

    // ============================================================
    // BASE RECIPE RESOLUTION
    // ----
    // Always try the LIVE BOM first; the fixtures are only a fallback so the
    // skeleton renders something. A fixture-sourced recipe cannot be posted
    // (no part.id / uom.id), which the drawer reports as a blocker.
    //
    // Rules encoded here:
    //  - groupdefault = 1 is mandatory. Without it a configurable BOM returns
    //    every option in every group (the mistake that inflated one BOM from
    //    $186 to $398 in Manufacturing/BOM_Cost.htm).
    //  - quantities stay in the BOM LINE's own UOM (bomitem.uomId), which often
    //    differs from part.uomId. The API takes an explicit uom.id per item, so
    //    nothing is converted - side-stepping the conversion bug that affects
    //    37/110 BOMs in the stock AvailableToBuild.jrxml.
    //  - only typeid 20 (Raw Good) and 10 (Finished Good) become items. typeid
    //    40 (Note) has no part; 30/31 (Repair) are out of scope for this range.
    //  - stage / sub-BOM lines are carried through so the drawer can REFUSE
    //    them: a nested build cannot be expressed as a flat item list.
    // ============================================================
    // Matched on fgbi.partid, NOT on a part NUMBER. The finished good of a BOM is
    // the PART, reached soitem.productId -> product.partId -> part.id, and that
    // part's num can differ from the product's num. Matching the BOM on the
    // product number therefore finds nothing wherever the two differ, silently
    // falls back to the fixture recipe, and reports "no active BOM found" — which
    // reads as missing data rather than as a wrong lookup. An integer id join is
    // both correct and cheaper than a string match.
    // preferBomId comes from the recipe configuration. A part can carry more
    // than one active BOM and "newest wins" is a coin toss, so when the pack
    // names one, that is the one.
    function bomHeaderSQL(partId, preferBomId) {
      var bid = parseInt(preferBomId, 10) || 0;
      return [
        'SELECT bom.id AS bomid, bom.num AS bomnum, bom.description AS bomdesc,',
        '       (bom.configurable + 0) AS configurable,',
        '       fgbi.id AS fgbomitemid, fgbi.quantity AS fgqty, fgbi.uomid AS fguomid,',
        '       fgbi.description AS fgdesc, fgu.code AS fguom,',
        '       fgpart.id AS fgpartid, fgpart.num AS fgpartnum, fgpart.description AS fgpartdesc',
        'FROM bom',
        'JOIN bomitem fgbi ON fgbi.bomid = bom.id AND fgbi.typeid = 10 AND fgbi.groupdefault = 1',
        'JOIN part fgpart  ON fgpart.id = fgbi.partid',
        'LEFT JOIN uom fgu ON fgu.id = fgbi.uomid',
        'WHERE bom.activeflag = 1 AND fgbi.partid = ' + (parseInt(partId, 10) || 0) +
          (bid ? ' AND bom.id = ' + bid : ''),
        'ORDER BY bom.id DESC',
        'LIMIT 1'
      ].join('\n');
    }

    // Every join is LEFT and NO typeid filter is applied, deliberately. A note
    // line (typeid 40) has no partId and a repair line (30/31) has no mapping
    // in the API's 'Raw Good'|'Finished Good' enum - if the query filtered them
    // out we could never SEE them, and would silently build an incomplete
    // recipe. They are fetched so they can be refused or warned about.
    // (AvailableToBuild.htm's buildComponentSQL INNER JOINs part and uom, which
    // is fine for costing but would hide exactly these lines.)
    function bomComponentSQL(bomId) {
      return [
        'SELECT bomitem.id AS bomitemid, bomitem.typeid AS bitypeid,',
        '       COALESCE(bomitemtype.name, \'\') AS bitypename,',
        '       bomitem.quantity AS bomqty, bomitem.uomid AS bomuomid, biuom.code AS bomuom,',
        '       bomitem.description AS bomdesc, bomitem.sortidconfig AS sortid,',
        '       (bomitem.stage + 0) AS stageflag, bomitem.stagebomid AS stagebomid,',
        '       (bomitem.variableqty + 0) AS variableqty,',
        '       COALESCE(bomitem.minqty, 0) AS minqty, COALESCE(bomitem.maxqty, 0) AS maxqty,',
        '       (COALESCE(bomitem.onetimeitem, 0) + 0) AS onetimeitem,',
        '       part.id AS partid, part.num AS partnum, part.description AS partdesc,',
        '       (COALESCE(part.activeflag, 0) + 0) AS partactive,',
        '       (bomitem.uomid = part.uomid OR uc.multiply IS NOT NULL) AS convok',
        'FROM bomitem',
        'LEFT JOIN bomitemtype ON bomitemtype.id = bomitem.typeid',
        'LEFT JOIN part part   ON part.id = bomitem.partid',
        'LEFT JOIN uom biuom   ON biuom.id = bomitem.uomid',
        'LEFT JOIN uomconversion uc ON uc.fromuomid = bomitem.uomid AND uc.touomid = part.uomid',
        'WHERE bomitem.groupdefault = 1 AND bomitem.bomid = ' + (parseInt(bomId, 10) || 0),
        'ORDER BY bomitem.sortidconfig, bomitem.id'
      ].join('\n');
    }

    // Returns { source:'live'|'fixture', recipe, bomId, bomNum, fg, hazards[] }
    // partId drives the lookup; partNum and productNum are for messages only, and
    // productNum additionally keys the fixture fallback.
    function resolveBaseRecipe(partId, partNum, productNum) {
      var pid = parseInt(partId, 10) || 0;
      // product.partId is nullable. An unlinked product is a DIFFERENT failure
      // from a part that has no BOM, and has a different fix, so it reads
      // differently rather than falling through to "no BOM found".
      if (!pid) {
        return Promise.resolve({
          source: 'none', recipe: null, bomId: null, bomNum: null, fg: null,
          hazards: [], refusals: [],
          blockedReason: 'Product "' + (productNum || '?') + '" is not linked to a part ' +
            '(product.partId is empty), so there is no finished good to build. Link the product to ' +
            'a part in Fishbowl.'
        });
      }
      // The pack may name the BOM to build against. A configured BOM that
      // cannot be found says so rather than silently using a different one.
      var cfgPack = packRecipe(partNum);
      var wantBomId = cfgPack ? (parseInt(cfgPack.bomId, 10) || 0) : 0;
      var bomNote = null;

      return qp(bomHeaderSQL(pid, wantBomId)).then(function (hdr) {
        var h = (hdr && hdr[0]) || null;
        if (h || !wantBomId) return h;
        bomNote = 'The recipe configuration names BOM id ' + wantBomId + ' for pack "' +
          (partNum || '?') + '", but no ACTIVE BOM with that id has this part as its finished ' +
          'good — the newest active BOM for the part is used instead. Fix it in Setup.';
        return qp(bomHeaderSQL(pid, 0)).then(function (h2) { return (h2 && h2[0]) || null; });
      }).then(function (h) {
        if (!h) return fixtureRecipe(productNum, 'No active BOM found whose finished good is part "' +
                                                 (partNum || pid) + '".');

        return qp(bomComponentSQL(h.bomid)).then(function (comps) {
          comps = comps || [];
          var hazards = [];
          if (bomNote) hazards.push(bomNote);
          var refusals = [];
          var outputQty = Number(h.fgqty) || 1;
          var lines = [];

          comps.forEach(function (c) {
            var t = Number(c.bitypeid);
            var label = c.partnum || c.bomdesc || ('bomitem ' + c.bomitemid);

            // The FINISHED GOOD (typeid 10) comes back here too, because this
            // query deliberately applies no typeid filter. It is already
            // resolved separately from the BOM header, so skip it silently
            // rather than reporting it as an unexpected component — it was
            // being flagged as a staged sub-assembly, which read as nonsense.
            if (t === 10) return;

            // A staged sub-assembly is `bomitem.stage` SET, or an explicit
            // sub-BOM line (typeid 50). stageBomId ALONE is not the test:
            // Fishbowl populates it on ordinary rows, so keying off it flagged
            // every component on the BOM (including the finished good).
            var isStage = (t === 50) || (bitTrue(c.stageflag) && !!c.stagebomid);

            // A nested build normally has its own moitem subtree and its own
            // work order (moitem typeid 50 -> 20 -> 50), and the API's items[]
            // is a FLAT list with no stage/nesting field — so a staged line is
            // flattened into a direct component pull here.
            //
            // That is a WARNING, not a refusal: this report's job is to resolve
            // the ingredient list and hand it over, and the operator reviews
            // every quantity in the drawer before creating. Refusing outright
            // blocked ordinary BOMs that merely carry optional or
            // variable-quantity lines.
            if (isStage) {
              hazards.push('Component "' + label + '" is a staged sub-assembly on the BOM. It is ' +
                'included as a direct component here, so the nested build is NOT created — ' +
                'check whether it should be pre-made instead.');
            }
            // 30 Repair Raw / 31 Repair FG have no mapping in the API's
            // 'Raw Good' | 'Finished Good' enum, so they cannot be emitted.
            if (t === 30 || t === 31) {
              hazards.push('Component "' + label + '" is a repair line (' +
                (c.bitypename || ('type ' + t)) + '), which has no equivalent manufacture-order ' +
                'item type, and is omitted. Add it by hand if the build needs it.');
              return;
            }
            // 40 Note has no part and no UOM - it simply cannot be an item.
            if (t === 40) {
              hazards.push('BOM note line "' + (c.bomdesc || label) + '" cannot be carried onto ' +
                'the order and will be omitted.');
              return;
            }
            if (t !== 20 && t !== 50) {
              hazards.push('Component "' + label + '" has unexpected BOM item type ' + t +
                (c.bitypename ? ' (' + c.bitypename + ')' : '') + ' and will be omitted.');
              return;
            }
            // A typeid-50 sub-BOM row has no part of its own to consume.
            if (t === 50 && !c.partid) {
              hazards.push('Sub-BOM line "' + label + '" has no part to consume directly, so it ' +
                'is omitted. Pre-make it, or add its components by hand.');
              return;
            }

            // Real consumable line from here on.
            //
            // variableQty is NOT reported here. It means the BOM quantity is
            // only a default, which is exactly how Infinit models the variable
            // items — and the recipe configuration then supplies the real
            // figure. resolveRecipe raises it only when the config DIDN'T,
            // because this function cannot see that outcome and would
            // otherwise tell the operator to set a quantity that is already set.
            if (!bitTrue(c.convok) && Number(c.convok) !== 1) {
              hazards.push('Component "' + label + '" has no UOM conversion between its BOM UOM (' +
                (c.bomuom || '?') + ') and its part UOM. The BOM UOM is sent as-is and nothing is ' +
                'converted, but double-check the quantity.');
            }
            if (c.partid != null && !bitTrue(c.partactive)) {
              hazards.push('Component "' + label + '" is an INACTIVE part.');
            }

            lines.push({
              partNum: c.partnum || '', partId: c.partid != null ? c.partid : null,
              desc: c.bomdesc || c.partdesc || c.partnum || '',
              uom: c.bomuom || '', uomId: c.bomuomid != null ? c.bomuomid : null,
              qty: Number(c.bomqty) || 0,
              minQty: Number(c.minqty) || 0, maxQty: Number(c.maxqty) || 0,
              oneTimeItem: bitTrue(c.onetimeitem),
              variableQty: bitTrue(c.variableqty),
              // Carried for DISPLAY only — a staged line no longer blocks.
              isFg: false, stage: isStage, stageBomId: c.stagebomid || null
            });
          });

          return {
            source: 'live',
            bomId: h.bomid, bomNum: h.bomnum,
            hazards: hazards, refusals: refusals, blockedReason: null,
            fg: { partNum: h.fgpartnum, partId: h.fgpartid, uomId: h.fguomid,
                  uom: h.fguom || '', desc: h.fgdesc || h.fgpartdesc || h.fgpartnum,
                  qtyPerBuild: outputQty },
            recipe: { bomNum: h.bomnum, outputQty: outputQty, lines: lines }
          };
        });
      }).catch(function (e) {
        dbg('BOM read failed for ' + productNum + ': ' + (e && e.message), 'error');
        return fixtureRecipe(productNum, 'BOM lookup failed: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e));
      });
    }

    function fixtureRecipe(productNum, why) {
      var fx = BASE_RECIPES[productNum];
      if (!fx) {
        return { source: 'none', recipe: null, bomId: null, bomNum: null, fg: null,
                 hazards: [], refusals: [], blockedReason: why +
                   ' There is also no fixture recipe for this product, so nothing can be resolved.' };
      }
      // NOTE the nulls: a fixture recipe carries part NUMBERS only, never ids.
      // That is deliberate - an id is only ever resolved from the database, so
      // a fixture-derived payload is not merely forbidden but unconstructible.
      return {
        source: 'fixture',
        recipe: { bomNum: fx.bomNum, outputQty: fx.outputQty, lines: fx.lines.map(function (l) {
          return { partNum: l.partNum, partId: null, desc: l.desc, uom: l.uom, uomId: null,
                   qty: l.qty, minQty: 0, maxQty: 0, oneTimeItem: false,
                   variableQty: !!l.variableQty,
                   isFg: false, stage: false, stageBomId: null };
        })},
        bomId: null, bomNum: fx.bomNum, fg: null, hazards: [], refusals: [],
        blockedReason: why + ' Falling back to the report’s FIXTURE recipe, which has no ' +
          'part or UOM ids — so it can be reviewed here but not posted.'
      };
    }

    // ============================================================
    // DUPLICATE-BUILD DETECTION
    // ----
    // IMPORTANT, and counter-intuitive: POST /api/manufacture-orders has NO
    // sales-order reference anywhere in its body (verified against the endpoint
    // contract). So an MO this report creates always lands with mo.soId NULL
    // and moitem.soItemId NULL. Those columns are populated only by Fishbowl's
    // own SO-to-MO linkage.
    //
    // A dedupe check written against moitem.soItemId would therefore return
    // zero rows for every MO this report has ever created - silently passing
    // every time while looking correct. That is worse than no guard at all.
    //
    // So provenance is written into mo.note as an anchored marker, and THAT is
    // the primary duplicate key. The soItemId join is kept for its own separate
    // purpose: spotting a Fishbowl-NATIVE MO already covering this SO line.
    // Same convention as ORDER_MARKER in Inventory/Replenishment_Transfer_Planner.htm.
    // ============================================================
    var MO_MARKER = '[SUPPWO v1]';

    function currentUserName() {
      try { return (JSON.parse((typeof getUser === 'function' ? getUser() : '{}') || '{}').userName || ''); }
      catch (_) { return ''; }
    }

    // ── MO numbering + per-line coverage ────────────────────────────
    // The MO takes the SALES ORDER's number, and one MO covers the whole
    // order: each custom line becomes a configuration, which Fishbowl turns
    // into its own work order on issue.
    //
    // Consequences that shape the code below:
    //  - `number` is now SENT (it was deliberately omitted before). That also
    //    means GET /next-number is never called, so its consume-on-read trap
    //    can't bite us.
    //  - A line added to an order that already has an MO can't join it:
    //    POST /api/manufacture-orders/:id is a destructive full-replace that
    //    regenerates every WO under the order. So the next build takes a
    //    SUFFIXED number (SO-40001_2) covering only the new lines.
    //  - Which lines a given MO covers therefore can't be inferred from the
    //    number. moitem.soItemId is NULL on REST-created MOs (the create body
    //    has no SO reference at all), so coverage is recorded in mo.note as an
    //    explicit line list and parsed back out.
    function moNotePrefix(soNum) { return MO_MARKER + ' so=' + soNum; }

    function moNote(order, lineNums, summaryLines) {
      var stamp = (typeof moment === 'function')
        ? moment().format('YYYY-MM-DD[T]HH:mm:ss')
        : new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19);
      var parts = [
        moNotePrefix(order.so_num) +
          ' lines=' + lineNums.join(',') +
          ' cust=' + (order.customer_name || '') +
          ' by=' + currentUserName() +
          ' ' + stamp
      ];
      (summaryLines || []).forEach(function (s) { parts.push(s); });
      return parts.join('\n');
    }

    // Pull the covered line numbers back out of a marker note.
    function parseCoveredLines(note) {
      var m = String(note || '').match(/\slines=([0-9,\s]+)/);
      if (!m) return [];
      return m[1].split(',').map(function (x) { return parseInt(x.trim(), 10); })
                 .filter(function (n) { return !isNaN(n); });
    }

    // Every live MO already attached to this sales order, from two angles:
    //   via 'marker'  - created by this report (number-matched, lines parsed)
    //   via 'soLink'  - Fishbowl-native, linked through moitem.soItemId
    // statusid < 50 keeps a closed MO from blocking a genuine re-run.
    // A LIKE test for "starts with this exact text".
    //
    // Needed because the suffix separator is now an underscore, which LIKE
    // reads as "any single character" — an unescaped 'SO-40001_%' would also
    // match SO-40001X2, so a build could be judged a duplicate of an unrelated
    // order. An explicit ESCAPE clause neutralises _ and % without threading
    // backslashes through two parsers (the string literal AND the LIKE), and
    // the escape character is escaped in the prefix too.
    function likePrefixSQL(col, prefix) {
      var p = String(prefix == null ? '' : prefix).replace(/([%_!])/g, '!$1');
      return col + " LIKE '" + escSQL(p) + "%' ESCAPE '!'";
    }

    function findExistingBuilds(order) {
      var soNum = escSQL(order.so_num);

      var sql = [
        "SELECT mo.num AS mo_num, mo.statusid AS mo_status, mo.datecreated AS created,",
        "       COALESCE(mo.note, '') AS note,",
        "       COALESCE(su.username, '') AS created_by, 'marker' AS via, NULL AS line_num",
        'FROM mo',
        'LEFT JOIN sysuser su ON su.id = mo.userid',
        'WHERE mo.statusid < 50',
        // Number-matched (mo.num = so.num, or a suffix), so a hand-edited note
        // can't hide an MO that already owns the number.
        //
        // BOTH separators are matched. New builds suffix with _, but an MO
        // created before that change carries -, and missing it would lose which
        // lines that MO already covers — i.e. build them a second time.
        '  AND (mo.num = ' + "'" + soNum + "'" +
          ' OR ' + likePrefixSQL('mo.num', order.so_num + '_') +
          ' OR ' + likePrefixSQL('mo.num', order.so_num + '-') + ')',
        'UNION ALL',
        "SELECT DISTINCT mo.num, mo.statusid, mo.datecreated, COALESCE(mo.note, ''),",
        "       COALESCE(su.username, ''), 'soLink', si.solineitem",
        'FROM moitem mi',
        'INNER JOIN mo ON mo.id = mi.moid',
        'INNER JOIN soitem si ON si.id = mi.soitemid',
        'INNER JOIN so ON so.id = si.soid',
        'LEFT JOIN sysuser su ON su.id = mo.userid',
        'WHERE mo.statusid < 50',
        "  AND so.num = '" + soNum + "'"
      ].join('\n');

      return qp(sql).then(function (rows) {
        return (rows || []).map(function (r) {
          var o = Object.assign({}, r);
          o.coveredLines = (o.via === 'marker') ? parseCoveredLines(o.note)
                         : (o.line_num != null ? [parseInt(o.line_num, 10)] : []);
          return o;
        });
      }).catch(function (e) {
        dbg('Existing-build check failed: ' + (e && e.message), 'warning');
        // A failed check must not read as "no duplicates" - surface it.
        return [{ mo_num: '', mo_status: '', created: '', created_by: '', via: 'error',
                  coveredLines: [], error: (e && e.message) ? e.message : String(e) }];
      });
    }

    // Which MO number this build should take: the SO number, or the next free
    // _N suffix when it's already used. Driven off the numbers actually present
    // rather than a count, so a gap (SO-1, SO-1_3) still resolves cleanly.
    //
    // UNDERSCORE, not hyphen: SO numbers routinely contain hyphens themselves,
    // so SO-40001-2 is ambiguous on sight — it reads as an order number as
    // easily as a second build of one. SO-40001_2 cannot.
    function nextMoNumber(soNum, existing) {
      var taken = {};
      (existing || []).forEach(function (e) { if (e.mo_num) taken[String(e.mo_num)] = 1; });
      if (!taken[String(soNum)]) return String(soNum);
      for (var i = 2; i < 200; i++) {
        var cand = soNum + '_' + i;
        if (!taken[cand]) return cand;
      }
      return null;   // absurd; treated as a blocker by the caller
    }

    // Line numbers already covered by a live MO on this order.
    function coveredLineSet(existing) {
      var s = new Set();
      (existing || []).forEach(function (e) {
        (e.coveredLines || []).forEach(function (n) { s.add(Number(n)); });
      });
      return s;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // BUILD DRAWER  (per SALES ORDER, not per line)
    // ----
    // One MO covers the whole sales order: mo.num = so.num, and each custom
    // line becomes one `configurations[]` entry, which Fishbowl turns into its
    // own work order on issue. So the drawer resolves EVERY custom line on the
    // order, shows one component table per line, and posts them together.
    //
    // Lines already covered by a live MO are shown but excluded from the build.
    // A line that can't resolve is excluded too, and named — the remaining
    // lines still build, and the excluded one can be fixed and built later into
    // a suffixed MO. Nothing is ever silently dropped.
    //
    // Mirrors PSFinish in WO_Finisher: the panel is fully re-rendered on every
    // state change (no incremental DOM), and every async continuation opens
    // with `if (active !== st) return;` so a drawer that changed underneath us
    // cannot clobber the new state.
    // ============================================================
    var CSBuild = (function () {
      var active = null;
      var stack = [];
      var inFlight = false;

      function els() { return { panel: document.getElementById('buildPanel'), scrim: document.getElementById('buildScrim') }; }
      function showDrawer() {
        var e = els(); if (!e.panel) return;
        e.panel.classList.add('on'); if (e.scrim) e.scrim.classList.add('on');
        if (stack.indexOf('build') === -1) stack.push('build');
      }
      function hideDrawer() {
        var e = els(); if (!e.panel) return;
        e.panel.classList.remove('on'); if (e.scrim) e.scrim.classList.remove('on');
        var i = stack.indexOf('build'); if (i !== -1) stack.splice(i, 1);
      }
      function closeTop() {
        if (!stack.length) return false;
        if (inFlight) { showToast('Still creating — please wait', 'info'); return true; }
        close(); return true;
      }
      function close() { hideDrawer(); active = null; }

      function findOrder(soId) {
        for (var i = 0; i < state.orders.length; i++) {
          if (String(state.orders[i].so_id) === String(soId)) return state.orders[i];
        }
        return null;
      }

      // ── Open: resolve every custom line on the order ─────────────
      function open(soId) {
        if (!csCreateAllowed()) { showToast('The Build action is disabled', 'error'); return; }
        var order = findOrder(soId);
        if (!order || !order.lines.length) { showToast('Sales order not found', 'error'); return; }

        var st = {
          soId: String(soId), order: order, status: 'loading',
          lines: [], existing: [], moNum: null,
          blockers: [], steps: [],
          created: null, issued: false, issueError: null, lastError: null
        };
        active = st;
        renderDrawer();
        showDrawer();

        // Existing MOs first: they decide the MO number and which lines are
        // already covered, both of which the per-line preflight needs.
        findExistingBuilds(order).then(function (existing) {
          if (active !== st) return;
          st.existing = existing || [];
          st.moNum = nextMoNumber(order.so_num, st.existing);
          var covered = coveredLineSet(st.existing);

          // Resolve each line's recipe in parallel — keyed on the PART, never
          // the product number (see bomHeaderSQL).
          return Promise.all(order.lines.map(function (row) {
            return resolveBaseRecipe(row.part_id, row.part_num, row.product_num)
              .then(function (base) {
                // The finished good's PART number keys the pack mapping, which
                // the per-serve caffeine conversion needs. Falls back to the
                // row's part when the recipe came from the fixtures.
                var res = resolveRecipe(base.recipe, row.qty_ordered, row._parsed.attrs, {
                  fgPartNum: (base.fg && base.fg.partNum) || row.part_num || '',
                  partIndex: state.configParts
                });
                var fgLine = base.fg ? {
                  partNum: base.fg.partNum, partId: base.fg.partId, desc: base.fg.desc,
                  uom: base.fg.uom, uomId: base.fg.uomId,
                  // perUnit is the per-PACK output; finalQty is that × the
                  // ordered quantity. Both are shown, so "was it multiplied?"
                  // is answerable from the table.
                  perUnit: round6(Number(base.fg.qtyPerBuild) || 1),
                  finalQty: round6((Number(base.fg.qtyPerBuild) || 1) * (Number(row.qty_ordered) || 0)),
                  userQty: null, dirty: false, isFg: true
                } : null;
                return {
                  row: row, base: base, comps: res.lines, fgLine: fgLine,
                  warnings: res.warnings.concat(base.hazards || []),
                  refusals: base.refusals || [],
                  covered: covered.has(Number(row.line_num)),
                  blockers: []
                };
              });
          })).then(function (lines) {
            if (active !== st) return;
            st.lines = lines;
            preflight(st);
            if (active !== st) return;
            st.status = buildableLines(st).length ? 'ready' : 'error';
            renderDrawer();
          });
        }).catch(function (e) {
          if (active !== st) return;
          st.status = 'error';
          st.lastError = (e && e.message) ? e.message : String(e);
          st.blockers = ['Could not resolve this order: ' + st.lastError];
          renderDrawer();
        });
      }

      // Lines that will actually be posted: not already covered, no blockers.
      function buildableLines(st) {
        return (st.lines || []).filter(function (L) {
          return !L.covered && !L.blockers.length;
        });
      }

      // ── Preflight: per line, then order-level ───────────────────
      function preflight(st) {
        var order = st.order;
        var soBlockers = [];

        (st.lines || []).forEach(function (L) {
          var b = [];
          var row = L.row;

          if (row._sample || state.source === 'sample') {
            b.push('Sample fixture row — its parts do not exist in the database.');
          }
          if (row._parsed.empty) b.push('This line has no customisation note.');
          row._parsed.unknown.forEach(function (u) { b.push(u.reason); });

          if (!L.base || !L.base.recipe) {
            b.push(L.base && L.base.blockedReason ? L.base.blockedReason : 'No base recipe available.');
          } else if (L.base.source !== 'live') {
            b.push(L.base.blockedReason || 'The base recipe came from the report fixtures, not a live BOM.');
          }
          if (L.base && L.base.recipe && !L.base.bomId) {
            b.push('No BOM id resolved — a configuration needs one to build against.');
          }

          // Hard refusals raised while classifying the BOM. Staged, repair,
          // variable-quantity and note lines are NOT in here — they are
          // warnings, because the BOM is the basis for an ingredient list the
          // operator reviews, not a contract that has to map perfectly.
          (L.refusals || []).forEach(function (r) { b.push(r); });

          // Every component must resolve to a real part + UOM.
          var unresolved = L.comps.filter(function (c) { return !c.partId || !c.uomId; });
          if (unresolved.length) {
            b.push('Unresolved component' + (unresolved.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ': ' +
              unresolved.map(function (c) { return c.partNum || c.desc || '(unnamed)'; }).join(', ') +
              ' — each needs a live part and UOM.');
          }
          if (L.fgLine && (!L.fgLine.partId || !L.fgLine.uomId)) {
            b.push('The finished good did not resolve to a live part and UOM.');
          }

          var positive = L.comps.filter(function (c) { return effectiveQty(c) > 0; });
          if (L.comps.length && !positive.length) {
            b.push('Every component resolves to zero — nothing to build.');
          }
          L.comps.forEach(function (c) {
            var q = effectiveQty(c);
            if (!isFinite(q) || q < 0) b.push('Component "' + (c.partNum || c.desc) + '" has an invalid quantity.');
          });
          if (!(Number(row.qty_ordered) > 0)) b.push('The line has no ordered quantity.');

          L.blockers = b;
        });

        // ── Order-level ──
        (st.existing || []).forEach(function (e) {
          if (e.via === 'error') {
            soBlockers.push('Could not check for an existing MO: ' + (e.error || 'query failed') +
                            '. Refusing rather than risk a duplicate.');
          }
        });
        if (!st.moNum) {
          soBlockers.push('Could not find a free MO number for ' + order.so_num + '.');
        }
        if (order.locationgroupid == null || order.locationgroupid === '') {
          soBlockers.push('The sales order has no location group, which the Manufacture Order requires.');
        }
        if (typeof runRestApiAsync !== 'function') {
          soBlockers.push('REST is unavailable — open this report inside Fishbowl with REST enabled.');
        }
        if (!buildableLines(st).length) {
          var covered = (st.lines || []).filter(function (L) { return L.covered; }).length;
          var blocked = (st.lines || []).filter(function (L) { return !L.covered && L.blockers.length; }).length;
          if (covered && !blocked) soBlockers.push('Every custom line on this order is already covered by an MO.');
          else soBlockers.push('No line on this order can be built — see the per-line reasons below.');
        }

        st.blockers = soBlockers;
        return soBlockers;
      }

      // ── Render ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
      function renderDrawer() {
        var e = els(); if (!e.panel) return;
        var st = active;
        if (!st) { e.panel.innerHTML = ''; return; }
        var order = st.order;

        var head =
          '<div class="detail-head"><div class="top">' +
            '<div class="detail-head-main">' +
              '<span class="so">' + esc(order.so_num) + '</span>' +
              '<h2>Create Custom Work Orders</h2>' +
              '<div class="sub">' + esc(order.customer_name || '') +
                ' · ' + order.lines.length + ' custom line' + (order.lines.length === 1 ? '' : 's') +
                (st.moNum ? ' · MO <span class="mono">' + esc(st.moNum) + '</span>' : '') +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="detail-actions">' +
              '<button class="close-x ps-btn icon" onclick="CSBuild.close()" title="Close">' +
                '<svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button>' +
              '<button class="ps-btn sm" onclick="openSO(\'' + esc(String(order.so_num).replace(/'/g, ''')) +
                '\')" title="Open this sales order in Fishbowl">Open SO</button>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div></div>';

        e.panel.innerHTML = head +
          '<div class="detail-body">' +
            bannerHtml(st) +
            blockerHtml(st.blockers) +
            existingHtml(st) +
            (st.lines || []).map(function (L, i) { return lineSectionHtml(st, L, i); }).join('') +
            actionRowHtml(st) +
          '</div>';
      }

      function bannerHtml(st) {
        var tone = 'warn', chips = [], action = '';
        var moStatus = FBLib.Settings.resolve('moCreateStatus') || 'Issued';
        var build = buildableLines(st);

        if (st.status === 'loading') {
          chips.push(psSpill('neutral', 'Resolving ' + st.order.lines.length + ' line(s)…'));
        } else if (st.status === 'submitting') {
          chips.push(psSpill('active', 'Working…'));
          (st.steps || []).forEach(function (s) { chips.push(psSpill('neutral', s)); });
        } else if (st.status === 'done') {
          tone = 'ok';
          chips.push(psSpill('success', 'MO ' + (st.created || 'created'), { dot: true }));
          chips.push(psSpill(st.issued ? 'active' : 'neutral', st.issued ? 'Issued' : 'Entered'));
          if (st.issueError) {
            tone = 'warn';
            chips.push(psSpill('caution', 'Issue failed', { title: st.issueError }));
          }
          action = '<button class="ps-btn sm primary" onclick="openMO(\'' +
            esc(String(st.created || '').replace(/'/g, ''')) + '\')">Open MO</button>';
        } else if (st.status === 'error' || st.blockers.length) {
          tone = 'late';
          chips.push(psSpill('blocked', st.blockers.length
            ? st.blockers.length + ' blocker' + (st.blockers.length === 1 ? '' : 's')
            : 'Nothing to build', { dot: true }));
          action = '<button class="ps-btn sm" onclick="CSBuild.recheck()">Re-check</button>';
        } else {
          tone = 'ok';
          chips.push(psSpill('success', 'Ready to build', { dot: true }));
          chips.push(psSpill('neutral', build.length + ' work order' + (build.length === 1 ? '' : 's')));
          chips.push(psSpill('neutral', 'MO ' + st.moNum));
          if (st.moNum !== st.order.so_num) {
            chips.push(psSpill('caution', 'suffixed',
              { title: 'MO ' + st.order.so_num + ' already exists for this order, so this build takes the next free number.' }));
          }
          var skipped = (st.lines || []).length - build.length;
          if (skipped) chips.push(psSpill('caution', skipped + ' line(s) excluded',
            { title: 'Already covered by an MO, or blocked — see each line below.' }));
          chips.push(psSpill(moStatus === 'Issued' ? 'active' : 'neutral',
            moStatus === 'Issued' ? 'Verify, then issue' : 'Create as Entered',
            { title: moStatus === 'Issued'
                ? 'Created as Entered, verified against the moitem rows, then issued — which is what generates the work orders.'
                : 'Created as Entered and left there: no work orders until someone issues it.' }));
          action = '<button class="ps-btn sm primary" onclick="CSBuild.create()">Create MO</button>';
        }

        return '<div class="pf-banner ' + tone + '">' +
                 '<div class="pf-summary">' + chips.join('') + '</div>' +
                 '<div class="pf-actions">' + action + '</div>' +
               '</div>';
      }

      function blockerHtml(list) {
        if (!list || !list.length) return '';
        return '<ul class="pf-blocker-list">' + list.map(function (b) {
          return '<li>' + esc(b) + '</li>';
        }).join('') + '</ul>';
      }
      function warningHtml(list) {
        if (!list || !list.length) return '';
        return '<ul class="pf-warn-list">' + list.map(function (w) {
          return '<li>' + esc(w) + '</li>';
        }).join('') + '</ul>';
      }

      function existingHtml(st) {
        if (!st.existing || !st.existing.length) return '';
        var live = st.existing.filter(function (e) { return e.via !== 'error' && e.mo_num; });
        if (!live.length) return '';
        return '<div class="dsec"><h4>Existing manufacture orders on this order</h4>' +
          live.map(function (e) {
            var lines = (e.coveredLines || []).length
              ? 'line' + ((e.coveredLines.length === 1) ? ' ' : 's ') + e.coveredLines.join(', ')
              : 'coverage unknown';
            // The whole point of naming an existing MO is so somebody goes and
            // looks at it before building another one, so each row carries its
            // own Open MO button rather than making the reader find it.
            return '<div class="pf-existing">' +
              '<div class="pf-note" style="margin:0">' +
                psSpill(e.via === 'marker' ? 'neutral' : 'caution', 'MO ' + e.mo_num) + ' — ' +
                esc(lines) + (e.via === 'soLink' ? ' (Fishbowl-native, linked via the SO line)' : '') +
                (e.created_by ? ' · by ' + esc(e.created_by) : '') +
                (e.created ? ' on ' + esc(fmtDate(e.created)) : '') +
              '</div>' +
              '<button class="ps-btn sm" onclick="openMO(\'' +
                esc(String(e.mo_num).replace(/'/g, ''')) + '\')" ' +
                'title="Open MO ' + esc(e.mo_num) + ' in Fishbowl">Open MO</button>' +
            '</div>';
          }).join('') + '</div>';
      }

      // One section per custom line: its status, note, and component table.
      function lineSectionHtml(st, L, li) {
        var row = L.row;
        var tag;
        if (L.covered)               tag = psSpill('success', 'Already built', { title: 'A live MO already covers this line.' });
        else if (L.blockers.length)  tag = psSpill('blocked', 'Blocked');
        else                         tag = psSpill('active', 'Will build');

        var summary = row._parsed.attrs.map(function (a) { return a.key + ': ' + a.level; }).join(' · ');

        var body = '';
        if (!L.covered) {
          body = blockerHtml(L.blockers) + warningHtml(L.warnings) + compTableHtml(st, L, li);
        }

        return '<div class="dsec">' +
          '<h4>Line ' + esc(row.line_num) + ' · ' + esc(row.product_num || '—') +
            ' × ' + esc(fmtQty(row.qty_ordered)) + ' ' + esc(row.uom_code || '') +
            '  ' + tag + '</h4>' +
          (summary ? '<div style="margin-bottom:6px">' + chipsHtml(row._parsed) + '</div>'
                   : '<div style="margin-bottom:6px">' + chipsHtml(row._parsed) + '</div>') +
          (row._parsed.raw ? '<div class="pf-rawnote">' + esc(row._parsed.raw) + '</div>' : '') +
          body +
          '</div>';
      }

      function compTableHtml(st, L, li) {
        if (!L.comps.length && !L.fgLine) {
          return '<p class="pf-note">Nothing resolved for this line.</p>';
        }
        var rows = [];

        if (L.fgLine) {
          rows.push('<tr class="fg-line">' +
            '<td><span class="pf-partn">' + esc(L.fgLine.partNum) + '</span>' +
                '<div class="pf-desc">Finished good' + (L.fgLine.desc ? ' · ' + esc(L.fgLine.desc) : '') + '</div></td>' +
            '<td class="num muted">' + esc(fmtQty(L.fgLine.perUnit)) + '</td>' +
            '<td><span class="cs-adj none">output</span></td>' +
            '<td class="num">' + esc(fmtQty(L.fgLine.perUnit)) + '</td>' +
            '<td class="num">' + esc(fmtQty(L.fgLine.finalQty)) + '</td>' +
            '<td class="muted">' + esc(L.fgLine.uom || '') + '</td>' +
          '</tr>');
        }

        L.comps.forEach(function (c, ci) {
          var q = effectiveQty(c);
          // Only an unresolvable line is an error. Staged / variable-quantity
          // lines are annotated, not condemned.
          var bad = (!c.partId || !c.uomId);
          var adj = c.adjs.length
            ? c.adjs.map(function (a) {
                var cls, txt, tip = a.attr + ': ' + a.level +
                  (a.perServe ? ' (' + a.perServe + ' per serve)' : '');
                if (a.kind === 'substitution') {
                  cls = 'sub';
                  txt = a.fromPart ? '→ ' + a.part : (a.part || a.level);
                  tip += a.applied
                    ? (a.fromPart ? ' — replaces ' + a.fromPart : ' — already the part the BOM carries')
                    : ' — could NOT be applied; the BOM part is kept';
                } else {
                  cls = 'set';
                  txt = a.qty != null ? '=' + a.qty : '? ' + a.level;
                  tip += a.qty != null
                    ? ' — ' + a.qty + ' per pack, from the recipe configuration'
                    : ' — no configured quantity, so this is the BOM figure';
                }
                if (!a.applied) cls += ' unapplied';
                return '<span class="cs-adj ' + cls + '" title="' + esc(tip) + '">' + esc(txt) + '</span>';
              }).join(' ')
            : '<span class="cs-adj none">—</span>';

          rows.push('<tr' + (bad ? ' class="bad-line"' : '') + '>' +
            '<td><span class="pf-partn">' + esc(c.partNum || '(unnamed)') + '</span>' +
                '<div class="pf-desc">' + esc(c.desc || '') +
                (c.bomPartNum && c.bomPartNum !== c.partNum
                   ? ' · <em>replaces ' + esc(c.bomPartNum) + '</em>' : '') +
                (c.stage ? ' · <em>staged</em>' : '') +
                (c.variableQty ? ' · <em>variable qty</em>' : '') +
                (!c.partId || !c.uomId ? ' · <strong>unresolved part/UOM</strong>' : '') +
                '</div></td>' +
            '<td class="num muted">' + esc(fmtQty(c.basePerUnit)) + '</td>' +
            '<td>' + adj + '</td>' +
            // The per-PACK figure that will actually be built. For a variable
            // item this comes from the RECIPE CONFIG and replaces the BOM
            // figure beside it; for a base ingredient it IS the BOM figure.
            // Shown separately from Final so the x quantity step is visible —
            // without it a coincidence (a config figure that happens to equal
            // the BOM one) reads as though nothing was applied.
            '<td class="num' + (c.fromConfig ? ' cfgq' : ' muted') + '"' +
                (c.fromConfig
                   ? ' title="From the recipe configuration, replacing the BOM figure of ' +
                     esc(fmtQty(c.basePerUnit)) + ' ' + esc(c.uom || '') + '"'
                   : '') + '>' +
                esc(fmtQty(c.perUnit)) + '</td>' +
            '<td class="num"><input type="number" step="any" min="0" ' +
                (c.dirty ? 'class="dirty" ' : '') +
                'value="' + esc(String(q)) + '" ' +
                'oninput="CSBuild.qtyChange(' + li + ',' + ci + ', this)" ' +
                'title="Resolved ' + esc(String(c.finalQty)) + ' — edit to override" /></td>' +
            '<td class="muted">' + esc(c.uom || '') + '</td>' +
          '</tr>');
        });

        var packs = Number(L.row.qty_ordered) || 0;
        var cfgRows = L.comps.filter(function (c) { return c.fromConfig; }).length;
        return '<div class="pf-tablewrap"><table class="pf-table">' +
            '<thead><tr><th>Component</th><th class="num">BOM / pack</th>' +
            '<th>Customisation</th><th class="num">Per pack</th>' +
            '<th class="num">Final ×' + esc(fmtQty(packs)) + '</th><th>UOM</th></tr></thead>' +
            '<tbody>' + rows.join('') + '</tbody>' +
          '</table></div>' +
          '<p class="pf-note">Read left to right: what BOM ' +
          esc(L.base && L.base.bomNum ? L.base.bomNum : '?') + ' holds for one pack, the ' +
          'customisation, the figure that will actually be built for one pack, then that ' +
          '× the ' + esc(fmtQty(packs)) + ' pack' + (packs === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' ordered. ' +
          (cfgRows
            ? 'The <span class="cfgq">highlighted</span> per-pack figures come from the ' +
              '<strong>recipe configuration</strong>, not the BOM — that is where the variable ' +
              'quantities live, so an admin can adjust them without touching the BOM. '
            : '') +
          'Every line is then multiplied by the ordered quantity. Quantities stay in each BOM ' +
          'line\u2019s own UOM — nothing is converted. Edit any Final qty to override it.</p>';
      }

      function actionRowHtml(st) {
        if (st.status === 'done') {
          return '<div class="dsec" style="text-align:right">' +
                 '<button class="ps-btn" onclick="CSBuild.close()">Close</button></div>';
        }
        var disabled = (st.status !== 'ready') || st.blockers.length || inFlight ||
                       !buildableLines(st).length;
        return '<div class="dsec" style="text-align:right;display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end">' +
          '<button class="ps-btn" onclick="CSBuild.close()">Cancel</button>' +
          '<button class="ps-btn primary" ' + (disabled ? 'disabled' : '') +
            ' onclick="CSBuild.create()">Create MO</button>' +
          '</div>';
      }

      // ── Handlers (invoked from generated inline attributes) ─────
      function qtyChange(li, ci, input) {
        var st = active; if (!st) return;
        var L = st.lines[li]; if (!L) return;
        var c = L.comps[ci]; if (!c) return;
        var raw = String(input.value == null ? '' : input.value).trim();
        c.userQty = raw === '' ? null : raw;
        c.dirty = (raw !== '' && Math.abs(Number(raw) - c.finalQty) > 1e-9);
        input.classList.toggle('dirty', c.dirty);
        // Re-run preflight without a full re-render, so focus stays in the input.
        preflight(st);
        if (st.status !== 'submitting' && st.status !== 'done') {
          st.status = buildableLines(st).length ? 'ready' : 'error';
        }
      }

      function recheck() {
        var st = active; if (!st) return;
        st.status = 'loading'; renderDrawer();
        open(st.soId);
      }

      // ── Payload ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
      // One configuration per buildable line. Each becomes a work order when
      // the MO is issued, which is what "multiple custom rows are just work
      // orders within the same MO" means in API terms.
      function lineItems(L) {
        var items = [];
        // The finished good is a PEER of the components inside items[], not a
        // separate field — a real GET response's configurations[].items[] holds
        // the 'Finished Good' row alongside the raw goods, mirroring the DB
        // (moitem typeid 10 is a child of the typeid 50 configuration root,
        // exactly like the typeid 20 raw goods).
        if (L.fgLine) {
          items.push({
            description: L.fgLine.desc || L.fgLine.partNum,
            type: 'Finished Good',
            part: { id: L.fgLine.partId },
            uom:  { id: L.fgLine.uomId },
            oneTimeItem: false,
            quantity: String(L.fgLine.finalQty)
          });
        }
        L.comps.filter(function (c) { return effectiveQty(c) > 0; }).forEach(function (c) {
          items.push({
            description: c.desc || c.partNum,
            type: 'Raw Good',
            part: { id: c.partId },
            uom:  { id: c.uomId },
            oneTimeItem: false,
            quantity: String(effectiveQty(c))
          });
        });
        return items;
      }

      function buildPayload(st, moStatus) {
        var order = st.order;
        var build = buildableLines(st);
        var shipDate = String(order.ship_date || '').slice(0, 10);
        var summaries = build.map(function (L) {
          var s = L.row._parsed.attrs.map(function (a) { return a.key + ': ' + a.level; }).join(' · ');
          return 'Line ' + L.row.line_num + ' ' + (L.row.product_num || '') + (s ? ' — ' + s : '');
        });

        var payload = {
          // The MO takes the SO's number. Because `number` is supplied,
          // GET /api/manufacture-orders/next-number is never called — which is
          // just as well, since reading it CONSUMES the number.
          number: st.moNum,
          status: moStatus,
          locationGroup: { id: Number(order.locationgroupid) },
          note: moNote(order, build.map(function (L) { return L.row.line_num; }), summaries),
          configurations: build.map(function (L) {
            var cfg = {
              bom: { id: Number(L.base.bomId) },
              // String, matching the psSubmitMo convention in
              // WO_Parts_Availability / Production_Scheduling — avoids float
              // noise on the wire.
              quantity: String(Number(L.row.qty_ordered) || 0),
              items: lineItems(L)
            };
            var s = L.row._parsed.attrs.map(function (a) { return a.key + ': ' + a.level; }).join(' · ');
            var cn = 'SO line ' + L.row.line_num + (s ? ' — ' + s : '');
            cfg.note = cn;
            if (shipDate) cfg.dateScheduled = shipDate + 'T00:00:00';
            return cfg;
          })
        };
        if (shipDate) payload.dateScheduled = shipDate + 'T00:00:00';
        return payload;
      }

      // ── Read-back verification ──────────────────────────────────
      // The REST GET normalises; the moitem rows are the truth.
      //
      // Structure: one typeid-50 root per configuration (parentid IS NULL),
      // each with one typeid-10 finished good and its typeid-20 raw goods.
      //
      // Components are compared as ORDER-WIDE TOTALS rather than per
      // configuration, deliberately: two lines can carry the same product with
      // different customisations, so a configuration cannot be identified from
      // its finished-good part alone. Totals still catch the case that matters
      // — if items[] MERGED with the BOM defaults instead of replacing them,
      // every quantity doubles — plus missing and unexpected components. The
      // root and FG counts carry the per-configuration structure.
      function verifyMoTree(moNum, st) {
        var sql = [
          'SELECT mi.id, mi.parentid, mi.typeid, mi.uomid, mi.qtytofulfill,',
          "       COALESCE(p.num, '') AS part_num, mo.id AS mo_id",
          'FROM mo',
          'INNER JOIN moitem mi ON mi.moid = mo.id',
          'LEFT JOIN part p ON p.id = mi.partid',
          "WHERE mo.num = '" + escSQL(moNum) + "'",
          'ORDER BY COALESCE(mi.parentid, 0), mi.id'
        ].join('\n');

        var build = buildableLines(st);

        return qp(sql).then(function (rows) {
          rows = rows || [];
          var problems = [];
          if (!rows.length) return { ok: false, moId: null, rows: rows,
            problems: ['Could not read the new MO back from the database.'] };

          var moId = rows[0].mo_id;
          var roots = rows.filter(function (r) { return Number(r.typeid) === 50 && r.parentid == null; });
          var fgs   = rows.filter(function (r) { return Number(r.typeid) === 10; });
          var raws  = rows.filter(function (r) { return Number(r.typeid) === 20; });

          if (roots.length !== build.length) {
            problems.push('Expected ' + build.length + ' configuration root(s) (moitem typeid 50), found ' + roots.length + '.');
          }
          if (fgs.length !== build.length) {
            problems.push('Expected ' + build.length + ' finished good(s) (moitem typeid 10), found ' + fgs.length + '.');
          }

          var want = {};
          build.forEach(function (L) {
            L.comps.filter(function (c) { return effectiveQty(c) > 0; }).forEach(function (c) {
              want[c.partNum] = (want[c.partNum] || 0) + effectiveQty(c);
            });
          });
          var got = {};
          raws.forEach(function (r) {
            got[r.part_num] = (got[r.part_num] || 0) + (Number(r.qtytofulfill) || 0);
          });

          Object.keys(want).forEach(function (pn) {
            if (got[pn] == null) { problems.push('Component ' + pn + ' is missing from the created MO.'); return; }
            if (Math.abs(got[pn] - want[pn]) > 1e-6) {
              problems.push('Component ' + pn + ': asked for ' + fmtQty(want[pn]) +
                ', MO has ' + fmtQty(got[pn]) +
                (Math.abs(got[pn] - want[pn] * 2) < 1e-6
                  ? ' — exactly double, which means items[] MERGED with the BOM defaults instead of replacing them.'
                  : '.'));
            }
          });
          Object.keys(got).forEach(function (pn) {
            if (want[pn] == null) problems.push('Unexpected component ' + pn + ' in the created MO (not in our item list).');
          });

          return { ok: problems.length === 0, moId: moId, rows: rows, problems: problems };
        }).catch(function (e) {
          return { ok: false, moId: null, rows: [],
                   problems: ['Read-back query failed: ' + ((e && e.message) || e)] };
        });
      }

      // ── The create flow ─────────────────────────────────────────
      // ONE create call, then verify, then issue. Never create-then-PATCH:
      // POST /api/manufacture-orders/:id is a destructive full-replace that
      // regenerates or deletes the work orders, and configurations are only
      // updatable while the order is still 'Entered' anyway. That is also why a
      // line added later gets a SUFFIXED MO rather than joining this one.
      //
      //   1. POST /api/manufacture-orders  status:'Entered' + N configurations
      //   2. read the moitem tree back and compare it to what we asked for
      //   3. mismatch -> DELETE the MO and report the diff (no WO ever existed)
      //   4. match    -> POST /{id}/issue  (this is what generates the WOs)
      function create() {
        var st = active; if (!st) return;
        // Checked BEFORE the first await — a disabled attribute alone is not
        // enough, since a queued click still fires the handler.
        if (inFlight) { showToast('Already creating — please wait', 'info'); return; }
        if (!csCreateAllowed()) { showToast('Creating MOs is disabled by your administrator', 'error', 4000); return; }

        preflight(st);
        var build = buildableLines(st);
        if (st.blockers.length || !build.length) {
          st.status = 'error'; renderDrawer();
          showToast('Cannot create — ' + (st.blockers[0] || 'nothing to build'), 'error');
          return;
        }

        var order = st.order;
        var wantIssued = (FBLib.Settings.resolve('moCreateStatus') !== 'Entered');
        var nativeDup = (st.existing || []).filter(function (e) { return e.via === 'soLink'; });
        var skipped = (st.lines || []).filter(function (L) { return L.covered || L.blockers.length; });

        var msg =
          'Create MO ' + st.moNum + ' for ' + order.so_num + '.\n\n' +
          'Work orders: ' + build.length + ' (one per custom line)\n' +
          build.map(function (L) {
            return '  line ' + L.row.line_num + '  ' + (L.row.product_num || '') +
                   ' ×' + fmtQty(L.row.qty_ordered) +
                   '  (' + L.comps.filter(function (c) { return effectiveQty(c) > 0; }).length + ' components)';
          }).join('\n') +
          '\n\nFlow: create as Entered, verify against the database, then ' +
          (wantIssued ? 'issue (generates the work orders)' : 'leave Entered (no work orders)');

        if (st.moNum !== order.so_num) {
          msg += '\n\nNOTE: MO ' + order.so_num + ' already exists for this order, so this build ' +
                 'takes the number ' + st.moNum + '.';
        }
        if (skipped.length) {
          msg += '\n\nExcluded (' + skipped.length + '):\n' + skipped.map(function (L) {
            return '  line ' + L.row.line_num + ' — ' + (L.covered ? 'already built' : (L.blockers[0] || 'blocked'));
          }).join('\n');
        }

        var tone = 'warn';
        if (nativeDup.length) {
          msg += '\n\nWARNING: MO ' + nativeDup[0].mo_num + ' is already linked to this sales order ' +
                 'in Fishbowl. Creating another may duplicate a build.';
          tone = 'danger';
        }

        psConfirm({
          title: nativeDup.length ? 'This order already has an MO' : 'Create Manufacture Order',
          message: msg, tone: tone,
          confirmLabel: nativeDup.length ? 'Create anyway' : 'Create MO'
        }).then(function (ok) {
          if (!ok || active !== st) return;

          // Always create Entered; issuing is a separate, later step.
          var payload = buildPayload(st, 'Entered');
          dbg('MO create payload:\n' + JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2), 'query');

          inFlight = true;
          st.status = 'submitting'; st.lastError = null;
          st.steps = ['Creating MO ' + st.moNum + ' (Entered)…'];
          renderDrawer();

          runRestApiAsync({
            method: 'POST', path: '/api/manufacture-orders',
            body: JSON.stringify(payload)
          }).then(function (res) {
            var num = (res && (res.number || res.num)) || st.moNum;
            if (!num) throw new Error('Create returned no MO number.');
            if (active === st) { st.created = num; st.steps.push('Created MO ' + num); renderDrawer(); }

            return verifyMoTree(num, st).then(function (v) {
              if (active === st) { st.steps.push('Verified against the database'); renderDrawer(); }

              if (!v.ok) {
                // Roll back cleanly — no work orders exist yet at Entered.
                st.steps.push('Verification FAILED — deleting MO ' + num);
                renderDrawer();
                return runRestApiAsync({ method: 'DELETE', path: '/api/manufacture-orders/' + v.moId })
                  .then(function () {

      function addLevel(ii) {

          var p = pack();
          var comps = (p && p.bomId && bomComps[p.bomId]) || null;
          if (comps && comps.length) {
            paintPicks(el, comps.map(function (c) {
              return { main: c.partNum, sub: (c.desc || '') + ' · on this BOM',
                       args: [c.partNum, c.partId, c.uom] };
            }), kind, ii, li);
            return;
          }
        }
        if (q.length < 2) { paintPicks(el, [], kind, ii, li, 'Type at least 2 characters'); return; }
        el.classList.remove('hidden');

      function paintPicks(el, rows, kind, ii, li, emptyMsg) {

          return;

        el.classList.remove('hidden');
        el.innerHTML = rows.map(function (r) {

              var label = String(lv.label || '').trim();

                var lk = normKey(label);

                else seenLv[lk] = 1;
              }
              if (isSub) {
                if (!String(lv.partNum || '').trim()) {
                  notes.push(lw + ' (' + (label || '?') + '): no part, so choosing it keeps the ' +
                    'BOM part and warns.');
                }
              } else if (numOrNull(lv.qtyPerPack) == null) {

      // ── Render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
      function render() {

        e.panel.innerHTML =

    function csLoadUserGroups() {
      userGroups = []; currentUserGroupIds = new Set();

      try {
        var rows = JSON.parse(runQuery('SELECT id, name FROM usergroup ORDER BY name') || '[]');
        userGroups = rows.map(function (r) { return { id: r.id, name: (r.name || '').trim() }; })
                         .filter(function (g) { return g.name; });
      } catch (e) { dbg('User group load failed: ' + (e && e.message), 'warning'); }
      try {
        var uname = '';
        if (typeof getUser === 'function') { var u = JSON.parse(getUser() || '{}'); uname = (u.userName || '').trim(); }
        if (uname) {
          var eu = uname.replace(/'/g, "''");
          var rows2 = JSON.parse(runQuery(
            "SELECT gr.groupid AS group_id FROM usergrouprel gr " +
            "INNER JOIN sysuser su ON su.id = gr.userid WHERE su.username = '" + eu + "'") || '[]');
          currentUserGroupIds = new Set(rows2.map(function (r) { return String(r.group_id); }));
        }
      } catch (e) { dbg('User group membership load failed: ' + (e && e.message), 'warning'); }
    }
