      var g = function (k) { try { return S.resolve(k); } catch (_) { return undefined; } };

      state.hideBuilt    = !!g('hideBuilt');
      state.unparsedOnly = !!g('unparsedOnly');
      state.sortKey      = g('sortKey') || 'date';
      state.sortDir      = g('sortDir') || 'asc';
      state.dateRange    = g('dateRange') || 'all';
      state.dateStart    = g('dateStart') || '';
      state.dateEnd      = g('dateEnd') || '';

      // Sets are mutated in place - reassigning them would break the MS closures.
      state.custIds.clear();
      (g('custIds') || []).forEach(function (v) { state.custIds.add(String(v)); });
      state.prodNums.clear();
      (g('prodNums') || []).forEach(function (v) { state.prodNums.add(String(v)); });
      state.soStat.clear();
      (g('soStatuses') || []).forEach(function (v) { state.soStat.add(String(v)); });

      var set = function (id, val) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.checked = !!val; };
      set('dsExpanded',  g('expanded'));
      set('dsHideBuilt', state.hideBuilt);
      set('dsDebug',     g('showDebug'));
      set('hideBuilt',     state.hideBuilt);
      set('unparsedOnly',  state.unparsedOnly);

      var sel = function (id, val) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el && val != null) el.value = String(val); };
      sel('dsDataSource',     g('dataSource') || 'auto');
      sel('dsMoCreateStatus', g('moCreateStatus') || 'Issued');
    }

    window.onSettingsChange = function () {
      var v = function (id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.checked : false; };
      var sv = function (id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : ''; };
      try {
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('expanded',       v('dsExpanded'));
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('hideBuilt',      v('dsHideBuilt'));
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('showDebug',      v('dsDebug'));
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('dataSource',     sv('dsDataSource') || 'auto');
        FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('moCreateStatus', sv('dsMoCreateStatus') || 'Issued');
        FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
      } catch (e) { dbg('onSettingsChange: ' + (e && e.message), 'error'); }

      var prevSource = state.source;
      state.hideBuilt = v('dsHideBuilt');
      var hb = document.getElementById('hideBuilt'); if (hb) hb.checked = state.hideBuilt;

      applyDebugDrawer(!!FBLib.Settings.resolve('showDebug'));

      if (v('dsExpanded')) state.orders.forEach(function (o) { state.expandedSOs.add(String(o.so_id)); });

      // A data-source change has to re-load; everything else just repaints.
      var wantSource = sv('dsDataSource') || 'auto';
      if ((wantSource === 'sample') !== (prevSource === 'sample')) loadAll();
      else render();
    };

    window.resetSettings = function () {
      psConfirm({
        title: 'Reset settings', tone: 'warn',
        message: 'Clear your personal settings for this report and go back to the published defaults?',
        confirmLabel: 'Reset'
      }).then(function (ok) {
        if (!ok) return;
        try { FBLib.Settings.clearUser(); } catch (_) {}
        hydrateSettings();
        MS.renderAll();
        updateSortArrows();
        loadAll();
        showToast('Settings reset', 'success');
      });
    };

    window.publishMaster = function () {
      if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) { showToast('Only an admin can publish defaults', 'error'); return; }
      psConfirm({
        title: 'Publish as default', tone: 'warn',
        message: 'Publish your current settings as the default for every user of this report?\n\n' +
                 'This replaces the published defaults. The admin Create-MO gates are preserved.',
        confirmLabel: 'Publish'
      }).then(function (ok) {
        if (!ok) return;
        try {
          // publishMaster REPLACES the whole object, so start from the current
          // master and overlay - otherwise the create gates would be wiped.
          var master = Object.assign({}, FBLib.Settings.getMaster(), FBLib.Settings.getUser());
          if (!FBLib.Settings.publishMaster(master)) { showToast('Could not publish — admin only', 'error'); return; }
          showToast('Published as the default for everyone', 'success');
          refreshAdminUi();
        } catch (e) { dbg('publishMaster: ' + (e && e.message), 'error'); }
      });
    };

    window.toggleUserEditing = function () {
      if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) { showToast('Only an admin can change this', 'error'); return; }
      try {
        var locked = !FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed();
        FBLib.Settings.setLock(!locked);   // setLock(true) = locked
        refreshAdminUi();
        showToast(!locked ? 'User editing locked' : 'User editing unlocked', 'success');
      } catch (e) { dbg('toggleUserEditing: ' + (e && e.message), 'error'); }
    };

    function refreshAdminUi() {
      var isAdmin = false;
      try { isAdmin = FBLib.Settings.isAdmin(); } catch (_) {}
      var sec = document.getElementById('dsAdminSection');
      if (sec) sec.style.display = isAdmin ? '' : 'none';

      // The recipe configuration is readable by anyone (the figures explain
      // what a build will do) and editable only by an admin — the editor
      // itself renders read-only for everyone else.
      var rb = document.getElementById('recipeBtn');
      if (rb) rb.style.display = '';

      var badge = document.getElementById('dsLockBadge');
      var allowed = true;
      try { allowed = FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed(); } catch (_) {}
      if (badge) badge.style.display = (!allowed && !isAdmin) ? '' : 'none';

      var lockBtn = document.getElementById('dsLockBtn');
      if (lockBtn) lockBtn.textContent = allowed ? 'Lock user editing' : 'Unlock user editing';

      var en = document.getElementById('dsEnableCreateMO');
      if (en) { try { en.checked = !!FBLib.Settings.resolve('enableCreateMO'); } catch (_) {} }

      var sel = document.getElementById('dsCreateMOGroup');
      if (sel) {
        var cur = '';
        try { cur = String(FBLib.Settings.resolve('createMOGroupId') || ''); } catch (_) {}
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">All users</option>' + userGroups.map(function (g) {
          return '<option value="' + esc(g.id) + '"' + (String(g.id) === cur ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + esc(g.name) + '</option>';
        }).join('');
      }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // DEBUG DRAWER (fb-lib) - the observer keeps --debug-drawer-h in sync so
    // the body reserves the right amount of bottom padding.
    // ============================================================
    var _debugApi = null;
    function applyDebugDrawer(on) {
      try {
        if (!_debugApi) {
          _debugApi = FBLib.Common.mountDebugDrawer();
          if (_debugApi && _debugApi.element) observeDebugDrawer(_debugApi.element);
        }
        if (!_debugApi) return;
        if (on) { _debugApi.show(); _debugApi.expand(); } else { _debugApi.hide(); }
      } catch (e) { try { console.warn('debug drawer:', e); } catch (_) {} }
    }

    function observeDebugDrawer(el) {
      if (!el) return;
      function sync() {
        var visible = el.classList.contains('is-visible');
        var h = visible ? el.offsetHeight : 0;
        document.body.style.setProperty('--debug-drawer-h', h + 'px');
      }
      try { new ResizeObserver(sync).observe(el); } catch (_) {}
      try { new MutationObserver(sync).observe(el, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class', 'style'] }); } catch (_) {}
      sync();
    }

    // ============================================================
    // SEARCH + GLOBAL KEYS
    // ============================================================
    var searchTimer = null;
    var searchEl = document.getElementById('searchInput');
    if (searchEl) {
      searchEl.addEventListener('input', function () {
        clearTimeout(searchTimer);
        searchTimer = setTimeout(function () {
          state.search = searchEl.value || '';
          render();
        }, 200);
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
      if (CSSetup.closeTop()) { e.preventDefault(); return; }
      if (CSBuild.closeTop()) { e.preventDefault(); return; }
      MS.closeAll();
    });

    // ============================================================
    // INIT
    // ============================================================
    FBMfg.setLogger(function (t, m) { dbg(m, t); });
    FBMfg.setDiag(function (m) { psDiag(m); });

    FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'setOverlay',  triggerId: 'setBtn'  });
    FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'helpOverlay', triggerId: 'helpBtn' });

    csLoadUserGroups();
    hydrateSettings();
    applyDebugDrawer(!!FBLib.Settings.resolve('showDebug'));
    refreshAdminUi();

    // Hydrate the date-range controls from the restored state.
    (function () {
      var sel = document.getElementById('dateRangeSel');
      if (sel) sel.value = state.dateRange || 'all';
      var custom = document.getElementById('customDateInputs');
      if (custom) custom.style.display = (state.dateRange === 'custom') ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
      var ds = document.getElementById('dateStart'); if (ds) ds.value = state.dateStart || '';
      var de = document.getElementById('dateEnd');   if (de) de.value = state.dateEnd   || '';
    })();

    updateSortArrows();
    setStatus('Loading reference data…');
    showSpinner(true, 'Loading reference data…');

    loadReferenceData().then(function () {
      MS.renderAll();
      return loadAll();
    }).catch(function (e) {
      showSpinner(false);
      setStatus('Initialisation failed: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e));
      dbg('init failed: ' + (e && e.message), 'error');
    });

  })();
  </script>
